jobs.description:
Wir sind:

TORNER BRAND MEDIA
ist eine etablierte Content Marketing Agentur im Herzen von Hamburg. Seit über 20 Jahren entwickeln wir kreative Kampagnen und visuelle Content-Strategien für führende Marken. Zu unseren Referenzen gehören unter anderem Niederegger
, Ragman Casualwear
, Alnatura, Lindt, Kaufland, Budni, Gräfe und Unzer sowie Hamburger Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften. Wir lieben herausragende Kreation, stilprägende Ästhetik und glauben fest an den messbaren Erfolg starker Ideen.

Wir suchen: Einen kreativen und konzeptionsstarken (Senior) Art Director / Creative Director (m/w/d)
, der insbesondere für unsere Key-Accounts im Bereich FMCG (z. B. Niederegger)
und Fashion/Lifestyle (z. B. Ragman Casualwear)
die visuelle Markenführung und Kampagnenentwicklung übernimmt.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung aus namhaften Werbe- oder Digitalagenturen mit, hast ein exzellentes Gespür für moderne Markenwelten und übersetzt Strategien treffsicher in aufmerksamkeitsstarke Multi-Channel-Konzepte.

Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Leitideen und visueller Konzepte für unsere FMCG- und Fashion-Kunden (vom Big Picture bis zum Social-Asset).
Social & Digital First Art Direction:
Konzeption und High-End-Gestaltung digitaler Assets (Social Media Static/Motion, Performance Ads, Newsletter, Landingpages, Shop- & App-Content).
Content Creation & KI-Workflows:
Erstellung und Veredelung von Bild- und Bewegtbildmaterial unter Einsatz modernster Generative-AI-Tools (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Seedream) sowie klassischer Postproduktion.
UX & Brand Experience:
Gestaltung ganzheitlicher visueller Erlebnisse, die die Brand Identity stärken und die User Experience optimieren.
Strategischer Sparringspartner:
Beratung unserer Kunden bei visuellen Fragestellungen und Präsentation von kreativen Konzepten.

Dein Profil: Fundierte Agenturerfahrung:
Erforderlich sind mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Art Director oder Senior Designer in einer Werbe- oder Content-Marketing-Agentur.
Branchen-Know-how:
Nachweisbare Erfahrung bei der visuellen Betreuung von Marken aus den Bereichen FMCG
, Food/Gourmet
oder Fashion/Fashion-Retail/Lifestyle
.
Exzellenter Design-Anspruch:
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Visuelle Kommunikation oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Profi-Toolstack:
Sichere Anwendung der Adobe Creative Cloud
(Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) und Figma
. Erfahren im Umgang mit generativen KI-Design-Tools.
Gespür für Trends:
Starkes Gespür für Typografie, Bildsprache, Zeitgeist, Fashion-Trends und Content-Marketing-Mechaniken.
Arbeitsort:
Du bist in Hamburg oder im nahen Umland ansässig (für hybrides Arbeiten und persönliche Abstimmungen im Studio).

Wir bieten dir: Attraktives Vergütungspaket:
Leistungsgerechte, branchenübliche Honorierung sowie individuelle Boni.
Starke Marken & Gestaltungsfreiraum:
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten für namenhafte Lovebrands.
Flexibilität:
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
High-End-Equipment:
MacBook Pro / Apple-Equipment für Homeoffice und Agentur.
Kreative Agenturkultur:
Ein eingespieltes, wertschätzendes Team in einem hellen, zentral gelegenen Office in der Hamburger Innenstadt – inklusive Rocket Milano Espresso-Bar und Agenturhund.

Kontakt & Bewerbung Auf deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive Portfolio/Arbeitsproben
freut sich Sven Torner

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director Copy (Remote US)
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Directive is a revenue-first marketing consultancy built to serve B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, industrial, and commerce brands. We don't make things look good for its own sake. We build visual systems that hold up under the pressure of performance channels, complex professional services positioning, and a buying audience that starts with a CMO and ends with a CFO.

We are looking for an Associate Creative Director who will translate Moments that Matter into creative territories, messaging hypotheses, campaign concepts, headlines, CTAs, and copy direction that designers can execute against.  The Associate Creative Director will bring senior-level creative judgment to work that is fast-moving, digital-first, and tied directly to business outcomes. This person will not simply wait for polished briefs or execute one-off design requests. They will help shape the ask, identify stronger creative angles, and translate strategic inputs into assets that feel clear, compelling, and differentiated.  They will represent creative in strategic new-business and portfolio-sales opportunities, help build speculative and portfolio creative, and support Directive’s move toward campaign-style case studies that can drive account growth and new revenue.

This is an individual contributor role — no direct reports — but the work will be high-visibility and the standard will be high.  The ideal candidate is copywriting-led and campaign-minded. They should have enough executive presence to participate in client and leadership conversations, but remain hands-on enough to write copy, review briefs, develop messaging territories, and shape creative direction without needing a fully staffed creative team around them. They should understand performance creative as a system of hypotheses, tests, learnings, and scalable winners—not just brand execution or asset quality.

Success means helping Directive replace deliverable-based requests with campaign briefs grounded in business objectives, buyer insight, test variables, and success metrics. The ACD should raise the quality of creative thinking before work reaches production, improve how Directive communicates to technical and enterprise buyers, and create the foundation for a scalable performance creative practice.


WILL OWN

Campaign Strategy

The ACD owns the idea, message, and creative direction before production begins — and helps prove that better campaign thinking can create better performance, stronger pitches, and more creative revenue.



Support new-business and portfolio-sales opportunities with speculative creative, campaign narratives, and stronger creative presence in strategic pitches.

Create the foundation for Directive’s strategic creative approach.

Primary responsibility is creative direction, campaign concepting, messaging strategy, and performance copy direction.

Turns campaign and creative briefs into territories, concepts, hooks, headlines, CTAs, landing-page narrative direction, and message sequencing.

Partners with designers by giving them a strong concept and copy direction to execute against.

Builds the early proof points, examples, and campaign-style case studies needed to support future creative revenue growth.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

30-day success signal: Internal teams understand why this role exists, what it owns, and how creative requests should start shifting from asset asks to campaign briefs.

Audited current creative requests, briefs, production workflows, pitch materials, and performance creative examples.

Met with Creative Production, Paid Media, Growth, Sales, Account leadership, and executive stakeholders to understand opportunities.

Defined what a “good” campaign brief needs to include before work enters production.

Created a first draft of the campaign creative brief template tied to Moments that Matter / Stratos.

Identified 2–3 priority use cases where the new model can prove value quickly, such as strategic account pitches, paid social campaigns, ABM campaigns, or portfolio-sales opportunities.

Produced at least one example of a stronger campaign territory or messaging direction from an existing work.

90-day success signal: Directive can point to live examples where creative strategy made the work sharper before production began, and stakeholders feel the new process is improving clarity, quality, and pitch readiness.

Run several real briefs through a campaign-level creative process: insight, hypothesis, concept, copy direction, production handoff, launch, and learning.

Developed creative territories, messaging angles, campaign copy, and testing recommendations for priority initiatives.

Supported at least one new-business, strategic account, or portfolio-sales opportunity with speculative or campaign-style creative.

Built a working partnership model with production designers so designers are executing against clearer concepts and copy direction.

Created early examples of campaign-style case studies or internal proof points.

Established a lightweight creative review rhythm focused on concept quality, message clarity, testability, and business relevance.

Begun defining the message/proof library and taxonomy needed for learning to compound across campaigns.

You have an established creative testing rhythm: hypothesis → variant → data → decision, repeatable without manual oversight.

Creative Expertise

A portfolio that shows range across brand work and performance creative — we need to see both a visual system you built and an ad campaign you designed that drove measurable results

Experience developing campaigns from concept through execution.

Ability to maintain and evolve brand standards across multiple channels.

jobs.description:
About ValidA little about us: We’re Valid, Valid isn’t just a performance or content agency. We’re a product-driven creative company with an in-house engineering team that builds tools to test, learn, and scale what works. We combine strategy, creative, and AI to turn insights into systems, helping brands move faster and make better decisions across every channel.



The RoleThis is a senior leadership role for someone who can sit at the center of client growth, creative performance, and internal execution, and make all three move faster.

Your job is not simply to oversee deliverables.

Your job is to make sure the work we put into client accounts wins.

That means understanding the client’s business deeply, recognizing that what they ask for is not always what they actually need, and having the strategic confidence to redirect, refine, and shape the work into something that outperforms what is already running.

You must be equally comfortable:

leading creative direction,

building testing strategy,

pitching directly to clients,

managing high-level relationships,

pushing back when necessary,

and translating all of that into clear internal execution.

This is a hands-on operator role.

You cannot lead this from above.

You must know how to build strategy, create strong concepts, understand AI production, and step into the work yourself when needed. The team should move faster because your expertise is in the room.

This role sits at the intersection of:

creative leadership, performance strategy, client trust, and speed.

The pace is aggressive.

Clients move fast. Ad accounts move faster. So do we.



What You’ll Actually OwnClient Strategy & Relationship Leadership

You will be the senior strategic voice on key accounts.

That means understanding each client’s business model, offer, funnel, and performance landscape, knowing what is working and failing in their account, and identifying where creative can become the growth lever.

Clients will often tell us what they think they need.

Your job is to identify the real problem underneath the ask and guide them toward the right solution.

You should be able to command trust quickly, pitch with confidence, and build relationships that make clients want to follow your lead.

Creative Performance Direction

You are responsible for ensuring the creative strategy is built to outperform.

This means:

building testing plans around real account opportunities,

identifying which hooks, offers, formats, and angles should be attacked next,

steering concepts toward performance over subjective preference,

and making sure every batch of work has a strategic reason for existing.

You are not approving ads because they look good.

You are approving ads because you understand why they should win.

The expectation is simple: our work should beat what the client was running before we got there.

Internal Team Leadership

You will lead internal creatives, editors, strategists, and producers with speed and clarity.

You must be able to take a messy client conversation, extract the strategic signal, convert it into actionable briefs, sharpen weak ideas, and keep production moving without bottlenecks.

You are the connective tissue between client expectation and final output.

Pitching, Selling & Expanding Trust

This role is highly outward-facing.

You should be able to present concepts persuasively, defend strategic choices, handle skepticism, and continually reinforce that we know how to make accounts perform.

Strong communication matters here as much as strong creative instinct.

Long-term retention often comes down to whether the client believes we see opportunities they do not.



Who This Is ForThis is for someone who:

understands performance creative deeply,

thinks strategically beyond what is asked,

can lead clients without becoming a yes-person,

can lead teams without babysitting,

can pitch with conviction,

and thrives in a fast, demanding environment.

This is not a clock-in, clock-out role.

Priorities shift. Problems appear. Speed matters.

The people who thrive here are the ones who know how to solve, adapt, and keep moving.

With operations across the UK, USA, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East, Kayana is committed to helping businesses thrive through innovation, digital transformation, and customer-focused technology.

Role Overview

We are seeking a creative, versatile, and results-driven Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
to strengthen Kayana's brand presence, develop engaging digital content, and execute integrated marketing initiatives across our international markets.

The ideal candidate is an all-around digital marketing professional
who combines creative storytelling, graphic design, video production, social media management, search engine optimization (SEO), and digital campaign execution to drive brand awareness, customer engagement, and qualified lead generation.

YOUR CREATIVE FIELD

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Performance Creative Strategist to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new Performance Creative Strategist, you will own one of the most direct levers of growth at Contabo Group, a profitable, fast-growing European cloud infrastructure provider backed by KKR and Oakley Capital. Across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube, you will decide which ideas get tested, which assets get built, and which concepts get scaled, giving you real ownership and real impact from day one.

You develop and execute creative strategies for every paid channel we run, translating audience insights and funnel data into sharp, performance-driven briefs. From there, you brief and collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and video producers to bring those concepts to life, and you build the A/B and multivariate testing frameworks that tell us which ones actually win. You read the numbers behind every creative (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS), know when to kill a concept and when to scale it, and turn those insights into channel-specific playbooks the whole team can build on.

Because we operate in B2B cloud infrastructure, this role comes with its own puzzle: turning technical, often complex value propositions into ad concepts people actually stop scrolling for. You stay close to platform updates, algorithm shifts, and creative trends across every channel we use, and translate all of it into a systematic testing framework rather than gut feeling.

You will report directly to our Head of Performance Marketing and work within an international, English-speaking team with a flat hierarchy, where you build creative processes from scratch rather than inheriting a rigid one. As we grow, so does the scope of this role, giving you real visibility and a fast path toward owning creative strategy end to end.

WHAT CONVINCES US

Your personality, paired with:

Senior track record at the intersection of creative and performance, spanning concepts, ad copy, hooks, and visual direction, with real ownership of creative KPIs, not just campaign KPIs
Proven experience acting as the creative bridge between performance marketing and creative or product teams, translating offers, product messaging, and campaign goals into platform-ready assets, and briefing designers, copywriters, and UX/UI colleagues with precise, performance-oriented creative briefs
Hands-on experience producing or closely directing assets for paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and video (YouTube, Reels, TikTok), including adapting technical specs to each platform and format
A strong visual and copy instinct, knowing what stops the scroll and what converts, paired with the ability to write sharp, conversion-driven ad copy from headlines and hooks to CTAs across formats and funnel stages, all backed by solid data analysis
Deep fluency in creative testing methodology, from A/B and multivariate testing to creative fatigue analysis and iteration cycles, along with the ability to read creative performance independently from overall campaign performance (ad strength, creative excellence scores, CTR, CVR) and turn that into actionable internal benchmarks
Audience and persona fluency, applying affinity groups, in market segments, and audience insights to creative decisions for each product line and campaign type
Comfortable managing Google Ads and Meta Ads end to end, including creative setup and optimisation
Fluent English and comfortable working in an international team

Should have:

Genuine enthusiasm for platform trends and continuous creative experimentation, combined with a collaborative communication style that keeps cross-functional stakeholders aligned
A data-driven mindset paired with genuine creative instinct, equally at home in a dashboard and in a brainstorm
Familiarity with affiliate partner creative requirements and specs

Nice to have:

Experience in B2B tech, SaaS, or the wider cloud and hosting industry
A portfolio or reel showcasing past creative work
German language skills or additional European languages, alongside fluent English

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Senior / Lead Creative Strategist

Simmer | London | Full-time

Simmer is one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer brands, built on a simple idea: healthy food should taste extraordinary. Founded by brothers Simmy and Jhai with £10 of ingredients, we've grown into a profitable, bootstrapped business generating over £100m in annual recurring revenue, ranking #5 in The Sunday Times 100.

But we still think we're early.

Our ambition is to become the defining brand in healthy eating.

We're fully founder-led, without private equity or corporate layers. The founders remain deeply involved in the business, decisions happen quickly and the people who join us have the opportunity to materially shape what Simmer becomes.

We've built our growth through product quality, performance marketing and founder-led storytelling. Creative has been one of our biggest competitive advantages, helping us reach tens of thousands of customers across the UK.

Now we want to take that advantage much further.

The opportunity

We're looking for an exceptional Senior / Lead Creative Strategist
who understands the relationship between creative, consumer behaviour and commercial performance.

Someone who can look at our acquisition engine, understand what is driving growth today and identify what could make it significantly better tomorrow.

You'll have access to meaningful paid media investment, high volumes of creative testing, rich performance data and a talented team of producers and editors who can bring ideas to life.

You'll work directly with our founder and closely with the people responsible for growth, helping determine which audiences we target, what messages resonate and where we invest our creative efforts.

This isn't a role for someone who simply writes briefs or comes up with interesting ideas.

We want someone who can answer the harder questions:
Why are certain ads outperforming everything else?
Which audiences and customer motivations are we not reaching?
Where are we seeing creative fatigue or diminishing returns, and what should we do about it?
Which new concepts, formats and messages could materially improve acquisition?
How do we turn individual creative wins into a repeatable engine for growth?
Where should we focus our time, creative resources and media investment to generate the greatest return?

You might be a senior Creative Strategist with exceptional performance marketing knowledge, or an experienced Performance Marketer with outstanding creative instincts.

We're open-minded about your background and title. What matters is your ability to combine commercial insight, creative thinking and execution to deliver measurable growth.
For the right person, the role could extend into broader performance marketing ownership.

What you'll do

Own the creative growth opportunity

Understand our acquisition performance, identify the biggest opportunities and develop a clear creative strategy to capture them. Think beyond individual campaigns to customer segments, positioning, messaging and sustainable growth.

Turn performance data into better creative

Go deep into Meta performance, CAC, conversion, creative fatigue, testing results and customer behaviour. Understand why something works, not simply whether it works, and translate those insights into clear creative decisions.

Develop concepts that move the numbers

Create and shape compelling concepts, hooks, scripts and briefs grounded in consumer psychology and commercial insight. Work closely with our production team, editors and creators to turn ideas into high-performing content.

Build a stronger experimentation engine

Identify what we should test, how we should test it and what we'll learn. Develop new angles, challenge assumptions, iterate quickly and scale ideas that demonstrate genuine incremental value.

Connect creative and media performance

Work across creative and performance to understand how messaging, audiences, spend and acquisition economics interact. Help shape decisions around what to produce, what to scale and where to focus investment.

Raise the standard

Develop a strong point of view on what great performance creative looks like. Challenge mediocre ideas, improve the quality of thinking and help the team become more commercially effective without slowing down execution.

Take ownership of outcomes

We're not looking for someone who measures success by how many briefs they've written or campaigns they've launched. We care about what improves as a result of their work.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in how impressive your job title sounds or how many people you've managed than the quality of your thinking, the decisions you've made and the results you've delivered.

You'll bring:
Proven performance impact.
You've helped improve customer acquisition through creative strategy, paid social or a combination of both, and can explain what you personally contributed.
Strong Meta and acquisition knowledge.
You understand the mechanics of paid social, creative testing, CAC, conversion and scaling performance.
Exceptional creative judgement.
You instinctively understand hooks, storytelling, consumer psychology, messaging and what makes people pay attention and take action.
Analytical depth.
You're comfortable working with performance data, spotting patterns, forming hypotheses and making decisions that improve commercial outcomes.
Experience at pace.
You've worked in an environment where creative is tested frequently, feedback is immediate and strong ideas are developed and iterated quickly.
Ownership and ambition.
You're comfortable taking responsibility, challenging assumptions and finding solutions without waiting to be told what to do.
Intellectual curiosity and humility.
You're constantly learning, testing your thinking and willing to change your mind when the evidence says you should.

Why Simmer?

A meaningful growth challenge

We've already built a £100m+ ARR business. The next stage isn't about proving the model works. It's about finding the opportunities that take us much further.

Real scale, without corporate complexity

You'll have meaningful media investment, performance data and creative resources, but still be close enough to the decisions to make things happen quickly.

Work directly with the founder

You'll work closely with Simmy, shaping the creative and commercial decisions that influence how the business grows.

Influence the work, not just the output

We want someone who challenges our thinking, identifies opportunities we've missed and raises the quality of decisions across creative and performance.

A role that can grow with you

We're open-minded about where this role develops. For someone with the right capabilities, there's significant scope to take on broader ownership across creative strategy, performance marketing and growth.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who's commercially sharp, creatively ambitious and intellectually curious.
Someone who can go from analysing acquisition performance to developing an exceptional creative concept, then work with a team to bring it to life.
Someone who has strong opinions but isn't attached to being right.
Someone who values pace, takes ownership and cares as much about commercial results as the quality of the ideas.
Most importantly, someone who's excited by the opportunity to make a measurable difference to one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer businesses.

If you love understanding why creative works, identifying growth opportunities others miss and turning those insights into commercial results, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and, ideally, examples of performance creative or acquisition initiatives you've led, the thinking behind them and the results they delivered.

Lead Productions from Brief to Delivery

Independently manage multiple productions, from initial brief evaluation and scoping through pre-production, shoot, post-production and final delivery.
Assess incoming briefs for creative feasibility, timing, resources and budget, and develop realistic production approaches.
Own project plans, schedules, logistics, resources, documentation and risk management, ensuring every stage runs smoothly.

Bring creative judgement and production expertise to discussions around formats, talent, locations, technical approaches and execution.

Take responsibility for production execution while working collaboratively with creative leads on the final output.

Own Budgets, Resources & Production Partners

jobs.title: Visual AI Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Join the Team Building the Future of AI-Powered Visual Creativity

For photographers, visual storytellers, art directors, and creative minds shaping the future of AI.



Aurify LLC — part of a global technology community with 60+ million followers worldwide — is looking for exceptional creative minds to help redefine how people create, transform, and experience photography with artificial intelligence.



We're not building another image generator. We're building a technology that understands why images matter — the emotion, meaning, composition, and creative decisions behind a photograph — so that millions of people can become part of extraordinary visual experiences.



This is not a traditional design role. This is a chance to help build the future of photography in the age of AI.



About The Project: Character Transfer

Unlike traditional face-swap technology, we're not just replacing one face with another.



We're building a system that understands the complete visual story of an image — why a moment feels special, what emotion it communicates, what makes the composition powerful, and what must stay unchanged for the image to keep its meaning.



The goal: when a new person enters an existing scene, it should feel as if they were truly there when the photograph was taken.



Not inserted. Not copied. Belonging.



Who We're Looking For

We need a rare combination of creative intelligence and technical curiosity — someone who sees beyond pixels and can read the emotional core, hidden story, and creative intention behind a photograph.



You may come from photography, filmmaking, advertising, fashion, VFX, digital production, or creative technology. Your background matters less than your ability to understand visual language.



Your Mission

You'll help build the intelligence behind our Character Transfer Engine, focused on three areas.



1. Teaching AI to Understand Visual Stories




Every photograph has creative DNA.
For each template, you'll define:
the story being told
its emotional purpose
the relationship between people and environment
visual hierarchy
what must be preserved
what can adapt


Example




A romantic image isn't just "two people looking at each other" — its true value is connection, anticipation, vulnerability, intimacy, trust.
A travel image isn't just "someone near a landmark" — it's discovery, freedom, adventure, achievement, memory.
AI has to understand that difference.


2. Designing Scalable AI Creative Systems

We're not looking for someone who manually perfects one beautiful image — anyone can do that.



We need people who can help build a system that delivers consistently excellent results across:

thousands of templates




millions of users
every age
every appearance
every body type
every culture
every photography condition


You'll contribute to:




AI workflow design
creative instructions
prompt architecture
transformation logic
quality standards
edge-case analysis
evaluation frameworks


3. Evaluating AI Results Through a Creative Lens

You'll help define what high quality really means by evaluating whether results preserve:




Identity — does the person still feel authentic?
Story — do they naturally belong in the scene?
Emotion — does their expression and body language match the moment?
Physical Reality — lighting, shadows, perspective, camera characteristics, skin texture, anatomy, natural imperfections
Artistic Value — does this look like a real moment that actually happened?


Ideal Background (One or More)

Photography & Visual Storytelling

Professional, commercial, or fashion photographers, photo editors, creative/art directors, cinematographers who understand composition, lighting, emotion, directing people, and visual communication.



Advertising, Fashion & Brand Creative

Experience with advertising campaigns, fashion or luxury brands, creative studios, or commercial productions.

You know great images don't just look beautiful — they communicate ideas.



VFX & Digital Production

Compositing, CGI, motion design, digital production pipelines.

Especially valuable: experience maintaining visual quality across large-scale production.



AI Creative Technology

AI image generation/editing workflows, multimodal AI systems, diffusion models, ComfyUI workflows, advanced prompting, creative automation.

Note: pure prompt-writing experience alone isn't enough — we need people who understand visual intelligence.



What Makes Someone Exceptional Here




The strongest candidates think in multiple dimensions at once.
A photographer asks: "Why does this image create emotion?"
A filmmaker asks: "What story is happening in this moment?"
An art director asks: "What should the audience feel?"
A technologist asks: "How can we make this repeatable at scale?"
The ideal person combines all four.


Who This Role Isn't For

This isn't for someone who only creates attractive AI images or experiments with prompts, or who optimizes a single result manually.



We're looking for people who understand creativity, build systems, and help AI learn the principles behind great photography.



Hiring Challenge

Candidates may be asked to analyze a collection of original photo templates and explain:




what makes each image emotionally powerful
the core story of the image
which elements must be preserved vs. adapted
how to design a system capable of maintaining quality across 500+ different people
The goal isn't one impressive image — it's designing the thinking behind thousands of successful ones.


Why Join Aurify

Your work will be experienced by a global audience of 60+ million people, shaping how they create, share, and experience visual memories.



Most AI tools today generate images from text.



We're building something fundamentally different:



A system that understands existing human creativity and lets anyone become part of meaningful visual stories.



You'll help define how AI understands:




human emotion
visual storytelling
photography
identi

jobs.title: Content Lead
jobs.description:
A bit about Plntd

Plntd is a plant brand in Dubai. We sell mainly through our own site (Plntd.ae). We sell plants and
pots. The pots, we make inhouse.
Content is the front door of the brand. It’s how people find us on Instagram and it’s what feeds our
paid ads on Meta.
Right now almost every video we put out, I shoot, write and edit myself. That’s the bottleneck. This
role exists to remove it.

What the job actually is

You’d own our content output end to end.
Not scheduling posts. Owning the whole thing that turns an idea into a published video or an ad,
every week, without me in the loop for production.
In practice that means:

1. Pre-production

• Have a deep understanding of our visual direction and creative goals.
• Manage our idea bank (2–4 week content plan) based on these goals
• Plant for the shoots (with freelancers) to execute on these ideas: write the scripts and shot
lists. Every piece should adhere to our creative goals, and have a clear structure (hook, reason
to hold attention, etc).
• Plan to make the most out of the videographers’ days: i.e. getting as much Broll as possible to
fill our content bank.
• Coordinate with Lana to make sure shots we need for ads are worked into production as well.

2. Production: getting it made

• Brief and direct freelance videographers on shoot days, roughly one a week or one a fortnight
• Plan shoot days so we get a lot out of them. Several scripted pieces plus a growing library of B-
roll each time. This can also include BTS shots
• Shoot simple things yourself on a phone/camera when a full shoot day isn’t worth it.
• Keep the footage library organised so clips are easy to find and reuse in the future.

3. Editing and shipping

• Edit all our organic reels. Target is 3 a week. CapCut, Premiere is okay. Ideally, DaVinci.
• Viedographers are expected to do edits based on their shots, but we canalso need to do
editing on top of that, in hour, to make use of our library.
• Cut ad variations from the same footage (different hooks, lengths, formats) and hand them to
Lana on a schedule
• Make sure everything looks and sounds like Plntd. Captions, music, tone
• Publish and schedule, write the captions and on-screen text

4. Analytics/looking at the numbers

• Sit with me once a week and go through retention on what we shipped. Hook rate, hold rate,
where people drop
• Use that to decide what we do more of and what we stop

What I’d hope to see in the first 90 days

• 3 organic reels a week, consistently, made without me beyond the weekly review
• A steady flow of ad variations going to Lana every week
• A tagged, reusable B-roll library building up from each shoot day
• A written-down content system. Idea bank, plan, brief, shoot, edit, publish, review

The experience I think it needs

• 3+ years making short-form video for a brand, a creator or an agency, where you owned the
result and not just the execution
• Editing experience in at least one proper tool. Fast, clean, comfortable with vertical, captions,
sound and pacing. This is learneable.
• You can write hooks and scripts, and you can walk me through why they worked
• You’ve briefed and directed a shoot before, even if someone else held the camera
• You understand what a paid media person needs from you and why
• You read the analytics and change what you do because of them

Nice to have

• You’ve built a content process at a small brand rather than inherited one
• You actually like plants, interiors or home. Not a requirement, but it helps
• Basic camera and lighting

What this role isn’t

• A social media coordinator who schedules posts and replies to comments. Community
management isn’t this
• A pure editor waiting for footage and a brief
• A videographer who needs someone else to decide what to shoot

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Description

Job Description

Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design

Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Berlin, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Berlin hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the German market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.

About The Role

As the Creative Strategist for Germany, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region — working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.

What You'll Do

Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights
Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams
Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for German audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments
Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project
Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics
Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For

You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the German market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.

You're Probably a Match If

You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)
You have a strong eye for platform-native creative and the frameworks to test, learn, and scale it
You're confident using performance dashboards, data tools, and measurement frameworks (including MMM and attribution) to drive decisions
You have genuine, deep knowledge of the German market and are fluent in German and English — additional languages are a bonus
You have strong experience briefing and iterating creative in cross-functional sprints
You have a growth mindset — analytical, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

About The Group/Team

Our Europe Marketing Group drives market-specific growth across performance marketing, brand, social, community engagement, and more. We work at the intersection of creativity and data, combining global thinking with genuine local understanding to drive meaningful outcomes in our priority markets. We grow through experimentation, creative excellence, and a deep belief that getting the creative right is the fastest path to sustainable growth.

What's in It for You?

Canva has grown hugely over the last few years, but we're only just getting started. Here's a taste of what's on offer:

Equity packages — so you share in Canva's success
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About BYD

Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature.
We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team.

BYD is a leading, high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operates in four core fields of IT, automotive, new energy, and rail transit and employs over 300,000 people worldwide. As a global pioneer in New Energy Solutions BYD is dedicated to building a zero-emission ecosystem.

Position:
Senior Creative Designer & Content Producer – Middle East

Location:
Dubai, UAE

Reports to:
Marketing & PR Director – Americas, Europe & MEA

Who We Are

BYD Group is a leading global high-tech company with businesses spanning automotive, electronics, new energy and rail transit.

As BYD continues its rapid expansion across the Middle East, we are strengthening the regional presence of our multi-brand portfolio – BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG – each with its own distinctive positioning, visual identity and customer experience.

Your Mission

We are looking for a highly creative, versatile and hands-on Senior Creative Designer & Content Producer based in Dubai to support the growing creative needs of BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG across the Middle East.

This is a hands-on creative production role, not a coordination-only position. The successful candidate must be able to personally turn briefs into high-quality creative outputs – from graphic design and presentation design to on-site content shooting, video editing and event recap videos.

You will support creative requests initiated by BYD’s regional and internal teams, working closely with HQ, regional Marketing & PR teams and local importer/dealer teams to understand market context, gather local inputs and ensure smooth execution.

While close collaboration with importers and dealers is essential due to the region’s business model, this role primarily serves BYD’s internal regional creative and communication needs, ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG.

What You’ll Be Doing

Creative Design & Execution: Independently create high-quality visual assets for regional marketing and communication needs, including key visuals, event materials, digital and social content, invitations, posters, internal communications and other creative deliverables.
Multi-Brand Creative Support: Develop and adapt creative materials across BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG, understanding the distinct positioning and visual language of each brand and ensuring the right level of differentiation.
Video Shooting & Content Capture: Personally shoot photo and video content when required, particularly during vehicle launches, motor shows, media events, VIP activities and other key regional moments.
Video Editing & Post-Production: Independently edit short-form videos, event highlight videos, recap videos, internal summary videos and other fast-turnaround content for regional communication needs.
Event Creative Support: Work closely with the regional Events and Marketing teams to support major vehicle launches, motor shows and brand events with creative materials before, during and after the event.
Presentation Design: Create and enhance professional PowerPoint presentations, transforming business content, strategies, reports and proposals into visually compelling, executive-level presentations.
Localization & Adaptation: Adapt global and HQ creative assets for Middle East markets while maintaining brand consistency and taking into account local cultural, language and market requirements.
Importer & Dealer Collaboration: Work closely with local importer and dealer marketing teams to obtain local information, assets and execution requirements, while ensuring that regional creative outputs remain aligned with BYD’s internal briefs and brand standards.
Fast-Turnaround Creative Support: Respond efficiently to urgent regional creative requests and be comfortable producing high-quality work under tight timelines, especially around product launches, executive visits and major events.
Brand Governance: Ensure all creative outputs strictly follow the respective brand guidelines of BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG, including typography, logo usage, visual identity, imagery and overall brand tone.
Creative Asset Management: Maintain organized regional creative assets, templates, source files, photography and video libraries to improve efficiency and consistency across future projects.

Key Results

Deliver high-quality creative materials for BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG efficiently and consistently across Middle East regional projects.
Provide strong in-house, hands-on creative capability, reducing dependency on external agencies for day-to-day and fast-turnaround creative requirements.
Produce high-quality photo and video content from major vehicle launches, motor shows, events and executive activities.
Deliver timely and engaging event recap and highlight videos following major regional activities.
Improve the visual quality and professionalism of regional presentations, reports and executive-level materials.
Maintain strong and consistent brand identity across all regional creative outputs.
Establish an efficient working relationship with regional teams, HQ and local importer/dealer marketing teams.

What You Bring

5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, creative production, visual communication or a related creative role.
A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent graphic design and visual communication skills across both digital and offline formats.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
Strong video editing capabilities, with proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional editing software.
Practical ability to shoot photo and video content independently, with a good understanding of composition, lighting, framing and storytelling.
Ability to independently create polished short-form videos, event highlight videos and recap content from raw footage.
Strong PowerPoint / presentation design skills, with the ability to transform complex business information into clear, visually compelling executive presentations.
Strong understanding of brand identity systems and the ability to work across multiple brands with different visual languages and positioning.
Automotive, technology, premium/luxury or lifestyle brand experience is highly desirable.
Experience working in the Middle East and/or with importer/distributor/dealer organizations is preferred.
Highly hands-on, proactive and comfortable personally executing creative work from brief to final delivery.
Ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Willingness to travel across the Middle East when required for major launches, events, content shoots and other key activities.

The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work.

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. jobs.description:
WIR SIND WIETHE

Wiethe gehört zu den führenden Content-Produktionsunternehmen Europas und ist Marktführer in Deutschland. Für internationale Marken wie adidas, Y-3, Tchibo, C&A, FC Bayern München und Peek & Cloppenburg entwickeln und produzieren wir Content auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau.

DEINE ROLLE

Kreative Konzeption: Entwicklung und fachliche Führung innovativer GenAI-Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und unterschiedliche Content-Formate.
AI Art Direction: Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Look & Feel, Bildsprache, visuellen Systemen und kreativen Qualitätsstandards für AI-gestützte Produktionen.
Hands-on AI Creation: Eigenständiges Testen und Kombinieren generativer AI-Tools und Modelle sowie deren gezielter Einsatz in Bild- und Bewegtbildproduktionen.
Markenübersetzung: Übertragung von Markenidentitäten, Briefings und kreativen Leitideen in eigenständige, reproduzierbare GenAI-Ansätze und Bildwelten.

Kundenverantwortung: Souveräne Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kunden auf Senior-Level – von der kreativen und strategischen Beratung bis zur Präsentation und Umsetzung.
Creative Technology: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Production und Technology, um kreative Ideen in technisch belastbare und wirtschaftlich realisierbare Produktionsansätze zu übersetzen.
Innovation und Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Identifikation neuer Modelle, kreativer Technologien und visueller Trends sowie deren Übersetzung in neue Bildsprachen, Formate und Content-Konzepte.
Wissenstransfer: Aufbau und Weitergabe kreativer Best Practices und Standards für den professionellen Einsatz von Generative AI.

UNSERE ERWARTUNGEN

Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Direction, Design, visueller Kommunikation, Creative Technology oder vergleichbaren kreativen Disziplinen.
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit generativer AI in professionellen kreativen Projekten und Content-Produktionen.WIETHE CONTENT / CAREERS
Creative AI Lead

READY TO SHAPE THE NEXT LEVEL OF AI CONTENT PRODUCTION?

About Us:

Outernet London: The Future of Immersive Culture

Welcome to Outernet, the UK’s number one most visited cultural destination, and one of the world’s most ambitious entertainment districts, where technology, culture and creativity come together in real time, in the heart of central London.

At the heart of the district is The Now Building, a first-of-its-kind immersive space featuring a four-storey, 360-degree 16K wraparound screen. With more than 120,000 visitors passing through each week, it has redefined how audiences experience content, transforming Outernet into the UK’s most visited cultural attraction. But what happens here goes far beyond what’s on screen.

Four levels below sits Outernet Live a 1,800-capacity live venue hosting concerts, club nights, fashion shows, premieres and cultural moments that shape London’s creative scene. Designed to push sound, light and production to the next level, it has quickly become a benchmark for live entertainment in the capital. Just steps away, on legendary Denmark Street (the historic home of British music culture) The Lower Third continues that legacy. A fiercely independent grassroots venue supporting emerging artists, it combines an intimate performance space, cocktail bar and basement club built for discovery, experimentation and creative freedom.

Outernet London isn’t just a collection of venues. It’s a platform for storytelling, a testing ground for new ideas and a workplace where producers, creatives, technologists and operators collaborate to create experiences seen by millions.

Whether you’re launching global campaigns, producing live shows or helping audiences discover something new, this is a place where ambitious people can make a real impact.

This is Outernet London.

Job Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Creative Technologist to join our growing team at Outernet. In this role, you will transform creative concepts into immersive, real-time digital experiences, leading innovative projects from concept through to live launch across both commercial activations and original creative content. Working with technologies such as real-time graphics, interactive installations, AR/VR and generative media, you’ll collaborate with clients, internal stakeholders and technology partners to deliver memorable experiences at scale. Support technical road-mapping and integration discussions with technology partners.

Real-Time Pipeline & Development

Integrate spatial audio with real-time builds for audio-visual synchronisation.
Build custom JavaScript and Node.js applications to support activations.
Support and update existing real-time content.

Hardware & Software Integration

Lead the integration of audience interaction and user experience technology within delivery platforms.
Troubleshoot technical issues and optimise installations for performance and reliability.
Maintain the render farm.

Pipeline Efficiency & Standards

Standardise content delivery specifications based on technical infrastructure.
Educate the wider business on user experience, setting best practices with practical examples and guidelines.

Culture & Organisational Impact

Contribute to building a vibrant and future-focused team.

About Al-Futtaim

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

Overview Of The Role

Al-Futtaim Automotive is building a Creative Lab to shape how its digital experiences look, feel and perform across a diverse portfolio of automotive brands.

We are looking for a creative technology leader who can unite product design, generative AI, social-first content and experimentation. You will lead a multidisciplinary team delivering distinctive, accessible and measurable experiences across websites, apps, e-commerce, vehicle configurators, owners’ portals, WhatsApp, social media and employee-facing AI interfaces.

It is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who understands that great creative work must do more than look good. It must engage, convert, learn and improve.

What You Will Do

Lead the Creative Lab: Build and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, research, creative technology, generative AI, social content and creative analytics. Strengthen in-house capability while managing agency and creator partnerships.
Build a multi-brand design system: Establish reusable components, design tokens and design-to-code standards that support distinctive English and Arabic experiences across web and mobile platforms.
Scale generative AI production: Develop production-grade workflows for copy, imagery, video, voice and personalized creative. Maintain robust controls for human review, OEM approvals, intellectual property, product accuracy, data privacy and brand safety.

Deliver personalized experiences: Turn customer segments and real-time signals into relevant content and interfaces across websites, apps, WhatsApp, email and other digital channels.
Make experimentation the default: Embed A/B and multivariate testing across interfaces, journeys and creative. Use evidence to improve conversion, engagement, usability, organic performance and cost efficiency.
Champion research and accessibility: Establish continuous customer research and ensure priority experiences meet WCAG 2.2 AA, Arabic and right-to-left requirements.

What You Will Bring

A Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Digital Media, Creative Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline
12+ years of experience across UX/UI, product design and digital creative
5+ years leading multidisciplinary teams
Proven ownership of a multi-brand or multi-product design system in production
Experience scaling generative AI content pipelines, with measurable improvements in speed, cost or production capacity
A track record of social-first content with strong organic performance
Experience leading A/B or multivariate testing with measurable uplift
Experience delivering personalization across customer segments or channels
Strong knowledge of interaction design, customer research and accessibility
Experience designing and producing content for English and Arabic audiences
A portfolio linking creative decisions to customers, commercial or performance outcomes

Experience in automotive, e-commerce, consumer technology, media or telecommunications is preferred. GCC experience would be advantageous.

Technical Capabilities

Your technical experience should include several of the following:

Design systems, Figma, design tokens and Storybook
LLMs, diffusion models, generative image, video, voice and avatar workflows
Social listening, creator content, video production, and hook and retention analysis
Personalization and dynamic creative optimization
A/B and multivariate testing, statistical power and behavioral analytics
Usability research, WCAG 2.2, RTL design and Arabic typography
Motion design, conversational design or real-time 3D visualization

What Success Will Look Like

Distinctive and consistent experiences across the automotive brand portfolio
Improved customer usability, engagement and conversion
Faster and more cost-effective content production through generative AI
Stronger organic performance from social-first content
Increased adoption of reusable design-system components
More relevant, personalized customer experiences
Creative and interface decisions supported by controlled experimentation
Accessible experiences with strong Arabic and right-to-left parity
Robust brand-safety, intellectual-property and product-accuracy controls

Ready to build what comes next?

If your experience sits at the intersection of product design, generative AI, social culture and experimentation, we would like to hear from you. Show us the systems you built, the teams you led, the production workflows you scaled and the measurable impact of your creative decisions.

Join us in building a Creative Lab where every experience is distinctive, every asset is designed to perform and every idea has the opportunity to prove its impact.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

jobs.title: Director, Brand Growth
jobs.description:
About Wego

Wego is a travel marketplace built in the Middle East and Asia. Millions of travellers use the Wego website and app to search, compare and book flights and hotels, either with our airline, hotel and travel-site partners or directly on Wego.

We are a technology company first. Teams are small, autonomy is high, approval chains are short, and AI is part of how every team works, from pricing to marketing.

Job Purpose

The Head of Brand Growth owns how Wego wins travellers before they search, and makes that growth measurable. You will own the Wego brand, social, and our creator and influencer programme, with your own budget and your own numbers. You will run them as a growth engine, judged on demand, conversion and repeat bookings, not on awareness and impressions alone.

This is a hands-on, experimental role inside a growth-led marketing team. You will work hand in hand with performance marketing, who buy your campaigns against the KPIs you set, and you will judge every brand and social activity by what it does further down the funnel. Our brand channels are already digital and addressable, so you will spend your time in the platforms and in the data, not in decks.

Key Responsibilities

Brand growth strategy
Own Wego's positioning, messaging, tone of voice and brand guidelines across our markets, including our brand character, Weegio.
Decide each quarter which audience segments and markets to grow, using our brand tracking, customer segmentation and competitive data.
Find what moves travellers from knowing Wego to considering us to booking with us, and build the plan around it.
Own the campaign calendar: seasonal tentpoles such as Ramadan, Eid, summer and national days, plus always-on activity.
Social and community
Lead the social team across Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, X and YouTube Shorts. The team makes its own content at platform speed.
Test formats, hooks and creative fast, then scale what drives traffic, installs and bookings.
Run community and social care as proof that Wego delivers: fast replies, visible problem-solving and a voice travellers trust.
Turn travellers' trips into stories through user-generated content and creator stays.
Creators and influencers
Run the creator and influencer programme as a growth channel: selection on audience fit, contracts, briefs, usage and whitelisting rights.
Judge creators on what they drive, such as cost per engaged view, traffic, installs and bookings, not on follower counts.
Work with the performance media team to amplify the creator content that converts.
Full-funnel growth with performance marketing
Own the brand budget line: reach and engagement media, creators and brand research.
Brief reach and engagement campaigns to Wego's performance media team, who buy and optimise them against the KPIs you set. One media desk serves all of marketing, and the budget and the targets stay yours.
Design brand-to-conversion journeys with performance, organic and CRM: engaged audiences that feed retargeting, landing pages that convert, and offers that bring travellers back.
Track how brand activity shows up in branded search, direct and app traffic, conversion rates and acquisition costs.
Experimentation and measurement
Run a constant test-and-learn programme across creative, formats, audiences, markets and offers.
Commit to a baseline and targets, and report against them in a written quarterly plan covering objectives, hypotheses, budget ask and committed numbers.
Prove causation, not just correlation: design market holdout tests on reach campaigns with our data team, and use platform lift studies where scale allows.
Make every brand and social number computable: listening, campaign tagging, and platform data flowing into our analytics.
An AI-first function
Run brand and social on AI: Claude as the day-to-day workhorse, platform connectors for actions, shared working folders for context, and Looker for every number.
Build and improve agents for the repeatable work, such as segment briefs, social listening, community reply drafts, creator shortlists and weekly reporting. Keep human quality gates on brand character, culture and Arabic.
Working across Wego
Work with the in-house creative studio, which serves brand within a fixed quarterly capacity share and crafts hero campaigns and the template system.
Work with organic and search on long-form YouTube and search content that carries brand stories.
Work with martech and data on tracking and measurement, and with product and customer operations so brand promises are true before they are made.

Experience

Qualifications & Experience

5 to 8 years in brand, social or growth marketing at a consumer technology, travel, e-commerce or high-frequency app business.
Experience working in a growth function, or closely with performance marketing, with KPIs that ran down to conversion: traffic, installs, bookings and acquisition cost, not only reach and impressions.
A track record of brand and social work that drove measurable growth, and of being held to the numbers.
Experience leading a small team and owning a budget across channels and markets.

Digital, data and performance

Digital native, with deep, current, hands-on knowledge of Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube, including how paid works: formats, bidding, frequency and optimisation.
You understand how performance marketing works, including attribution, retargeting, CPA and ROAS, and where brand fits in the funnel.
Data-driven and comfortable in the numbers. You know testing and measurement: A/B tests, lift and holdout tests, and marketing mix modelling concepts. Experience with Looker, Tableau or an equivalent BI tool; SQL is an advantage.

AI literacy

You already build with AI in your own work: research, production, analysis and workflow.
Experience with Claude or other generative AI platforms, and with automating marketing work, is a strong advantage.

Market knowledge

You know the MENA consumer and its platforms: what works and what doesn't, culturally and creatively.
Experience in South Asia or Southeast Asia is a plus. Arabic language skills are an advantage.

How You Work

Self-directed. You arrive with your own objectives, strategy and numbers.
Scrappy, hands-on and experimental. You would rather run ten tests and scale the two that work than perfect one campaign, and you still make things yourself.
Full-funnel. You think from the first impression to the booking, and on to the repeat booking.
Research- and numbers-led, with strong creative judgement.
A clear communicator who leads through others, across teams and without formal authority.

Nice to have

Travel, marketplace or multi-market consumer app experience.
Experience building a brand around a mascot or brand character.

1.Job Purpose

As an ID Creative Lead, you will provide creative and design leadership for high-end hospitality, residential, and mixed-use projects across the Middle East. You will lead the development of interior design concepts and creative direction, translating client aspirations, project requirements, and design briefs into compelling and commercially relevant design solutions.

Working closely with Design Principals, Project Architects, Interior Designers, and international design partners, you will establish and maintain the creative vision throughout the project lifecycle. This role requires strong design leadership, creative thinking, client management skills, and the ability to communicate and champion design ideas effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

2. Job Accountabilities Linked to Objectives

Creative & Concept Design:
▪ Lead the development of interior design concepts, creative narratives, mood boards, material palettes, FF&E concepts, and design presentations in response to project briefs and client aspirations.
▪ Establish and maintain a clear creative vision across projects, ensuring design quality, functionality, commercial objectives, and project requirements are balanced.
▪ Develop innovative and appropriate design solutions, continuously challenging and elevating the quality of the design outcome.

Design Leadership:
▪ Provide creative direction and design guidance to Interior Designers and project teams throughout the design process.
▪ Review design proposals, layouts, materials, finishes, FF&E, and other interior design elements to ensure alignment with the overall design vision.
▪ Work closely with the Interior Design – Technical Team Lead to ensure creative intent is effectively translated into coordinated and buildable solutions.
▪ Collaborate with architectural, landscape, lighting, FF&E, and other disciplines to achieve an integrated design outcome.

Client & Consultant Coordination:
▪ Act as a senior creative point of contact for clients and key stakeholders on interior design matters.
▪ Lead client presentations, design workshops, and creative discussions, clearly communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.
▪ Build trusted client relationships by understanding expectations and translating feedback into effective design responses.
▪ Collaborate with international interior design firms and Design Guardians to understand, develop, and maintain their design vision.

▪ Champion high standards of communication, collaboration, and design thinking across the studio.

Quality & Design Standards:

▪ Monitor design risks and ensure that design solutions respond appropriately to project requirements, brand guidelines, authority requirements, and industry standards.

Project Health:

performance.

Business Relationships:

▪ Support business development activities, including client presentations, pitches, interviews, and design proposals.
▪ Identify opportunities for repeat or future commissions through project engagement and relationship building.

Professional Development:
▪ Keep abreast of international and regional developments in interior design, materials, FF&E,
technology, and sustainability.
▪ Contribute to company’s research and innovation Hubs, with a focus on interiors, materials, design trends, and emerging technologies.
▪ Participate in training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to strengthen creative capability within the studio.
