jobs.title: Creative Video Producer
jobs.description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

Job Description

Location:

Milano, MI

The Role

Condé Nast Italy is looking for a Creative Video Producer to oversee the creative production of video related to Conde Nast’s prestigious brands in Italy, such as Vogue, Vanity Fair, GQ, AD. The person will support the local Head of Video, based in Milan, in ideating and executing video series that support the iconic attributes of Conde Nast brands in Italy, to drive audience growth across digital platforms and support monetization. Video output includes original, social video, and podcast content for global digital platforms (e.g. O&O, YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok); syndicated series for local markets and video franchises that transcend platforms and markets. The ideal candidate works in a fast-paced, social-first world; is a self-starter, and has a passion for Conde Nast’s iconic brands and a visual and story-telling aesthetic that is aligned to our brands.

Primary Responsibilities

Support Head of Video in the ideation and production/direction of video series that amplify Conde Nast’s brands’ iconic attributes, audience growth and monetization
Direct and maintain end-to-end ownership over video shoots
Work hand in hand with the Local Production Manager to deliver series on time, within budget, and to a high standard
Oversee calendars planning both for editorial and commercial projects
Manage and supervise workflows between planning and production departments
Alongside Production Management, facilitate logistics for shoots including but not limited to coordinating/booking crew, and equipment, managing/tracking location and talent agreements, location permissions, risk assessment, booking transport, and cost/budgets associated with production
Review, edit, and approve preliminary and final treatments, outlines, shooting scripts, scripts, casting, production schedules, budgets, and final versions of all assigned programs, with supervision from the Head of Video
Alongside Production Management, manage the post-production process, responsible for collecting all creative notes throughout, and ensuring deadlines are being met
Edit select videos and/or provide detailed notes on cuts provided by the Condé Nast post team

Primary Skills & Qualifications

3+ years experience producing and developing video content on various platforms with a passion and interest in internet culture and digital media
Professional working proficiency in Italian and English, both written and spoken
A demonstrable track record in production execution
Experienced at dealing with A-list talents, celebrities and experts (and their reps) with professionalism and discretion, as a face of the brand
Film and conduct interviews in the field, in-studio, or via all means necessary
Strong understanding of production and post-production workflow
Experience managing a slate of multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to shoot and edit short social contents through mobile apps
A strong knowledge of and interest in Conde Nast Brands
Ability to work collaboratively, receive feedback, and provide notes on projects is a must
Ability to hit hard deadlines
A master communicator and always a solution-oriented adult in the room

Salary Range

The position is expected to be classified from the 3rd to the 2nd level under the “Graphic - Editorial” Collective Bargaining Agreement, with an annual gross salary ranging from €32.600 to €40.000, in addition to a comprehensive employee benefits package. In Condé Nast, salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including - but not limited to - relevant skills, training, experience and education.

What happens next?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.

Every week here looks different: sharp strategic problems, high-calibre teammates, and real ownership over work that reaches some of the world's most ambitious brands. Outside the day job, there's run club, book and chess clubs, charity fundraisers, Thursday drinks, and enough team socials that work never feels like just work.

We hire for attitude and culture add first - not just experience. Curious, ambitious people who challenge how things are done, bring fresh ideas, and help shape the future of marketing.

Sound like your kind of place?

WHO WE HIRE

We look for attitude first. Smart, humble, proactive, genuinely curious - that's the shortlist. People who care about their craft without taking themselves too seriously. We build brave ideas, keep learning constant, and make sure everyone's voice counts.
If you're already using AI to work smarter, even better.

AI

We're looking for people who use AI to sharpen their work - not replace their thinking.
You don't need to be an AI specialist. You need to be curious enough to already be finding ways to use it: faster workflows, sharper insight, better creative options, smarter decisions. We want people who ask “how can this be better?” and treat AI as a tool to elevate the craft, not a shortcut around it.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist to join our growing social content studio. This role will shape the creative strategy for our clients, with a specific focus on paid social ad creative.

This role will work with the paid media teams and clients to identify the right creative strategy to deliver creative that supports paid social performance.

The Creative Strategist will then brief the work in the creative team and be responsible for the outcome. Charlie OScar has created an ad creative system that's designed to make the creative get smarter every sprint. The creative strategist will drive this system .

WHAT YOU'LL BE GETTING STUCK INTO

Develop and lead the creative strategy for our clients, ensuring their brand storytelling is engaging, effective, and rooted in insights.
Help develop Charlie Oscar’s content offering, creating processes and structures to deliver best-in-class creative solutions.
Collaborate closely with the paid media team to ensure creative assets are optimized for performance across digital platforms.
Provide strategic and creative direction to clients, helping them develop content strategies that drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversion.
Lead ideation sessions and craft compelling campaign concepts that bring brand stories to life.
Identify and stay ahead of digital and social trends, seamlessly blending cultural, audience, data and brand insights into creative outputs that help clients remain cutting-edge.
To have an up to date and forward looking perspective on social-first creative, and be a thought leader in digital advertising creative.
Support new business pitches by providing creative strategic input and developing concepts that showcase our expertise.
Build a team and network of partners, including designers, copywriters, and content creators, to bring ideas to life.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven experience in a creative strategy role within a digital or social agency.
Deep expertise in digital and social media platforms, trends, and best practices.
A brilliant creative storyteller with a track record of developing compelling campaigns.
A strategic thinker who can connect creativity with business impact.
Experience working with performance marketing teams to develop high-performing content.
A strong understanding of brand positioning and audience insights.
Excellent presentation skills – confident in selling ideas both internally and externally.
Entrepreneurial mindset, excited about building a department and growing an offering within an agency

BENEFITS

Competitive salary, plus a performance-based bonus paid every 6 months
Wellness allowance, including access to Bupa private healthcare
Pension plan
Regular team socials and an annual company away day
Hybrid working - 3/4 days in the office, 1 day from home
25 days' holiday, plus bank holidays and flexible time over Christmas
4 weeks ‘Work From Anywhere’ per year
Your birthday off
Cycle to Work Scheme with Forest Bikes
Eye care vouchers
Regular office treats and surprises
Be part of building something truly exceptional
Working on innovative, exciting brands

WHAT MAKES US US - OUR VALUES

Our values aren't posters on the wall. They show up in how we work, how we treat each other, and how we build something brilliant together.

Make It Happen

Momentum matters. Progress beats perfection every time.

Treat It Like Your Own

Think like an owner. Care for every detail as if it were your money, your brand, your business.

Grow Together

Build the business, lift your team, and invest in your own growth along the way.

Be Brave

Description

Job Description

Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design

Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Istanbul, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Istanbul hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the Turkish market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.

About The Role

As the Creative Strategist for Turkiye, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region - working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.

What You'll Do

Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights
Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams
Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for Turkish audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments
Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project
Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics
Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For

You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the Turkish market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.

You're Probably a Match If

You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)
You have a strong eye for platform-native creative and the frameworks to test, learn, and scale it
You're confident using performance dashboards, data tools, and measurement frameworks (including MMM and attribution) to drive decisions
You have genuine, deep knowledge of the Turkish market and are fluent in Turkish and English — additional languages are a bonus
You have strong experience briefing and iterating creative in cross-functional sprints
You have a growth mindset — analytical, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

About The Group/Team

Our Europe Marketing Group drives market-specific growth across performance marketing, brand, social, community engagement, and more. We work at the intersection of creativity and data, combining global thinking with genuine local understanding to drive meaningful outcomes in our priority markets. We grow through experimentation, creative excellence, and a deep belief that getting the creative right is the fastest path to sustainable growth.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Brand & Communications Lead  (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
jobs.description:
Small and medium businesses are the backbone of the German economy, and a painful share of their time and cash disappears into compliance. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. Mandatory, joyless, overpriced.

We are building the infrastructure that changes it. Since none of this work is optional, it is closer to infrastructure than to software, and our reason to do it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

Eight months took us from 100 to more than 700 customers, and we are still small. That shapes every role here: a whole area to own, more to build than there are people, and scope that expands with you. English is our working language, the team is international, the market is German.

Tasks

We are looking for a very particular kind of person.

Somebody who can move a brand forward in words, in images and emotionally, all three at once. How we come across is one thing, not three, and it falls apart the moment the copy, the visuals and the feeling get decided separately by people pulling in different directions.

Here is why it matters more here than in most companies. Our subject is bookkeeping, finance and annual accounts. Objectively one of the least exciting things a business owner deals with, and an industry that looks and sounds exactly like that. Our entire bet is that we do not feel like that industry: approachable, likeable, close to the customer, never intimidating. Somebody has to hold that line in every ad, every page, every video and every email, and keep holding it as the volume goes up.

We are asking people to hand over their books. Whether they trust us enough to do that is largely decided by how we come across, long before anybody speaks to sales. That is why this is one of our first senior hires rather than a later one.

how the job actually works

You make things. With AI in the loop, and without needing somebody else to execute before anything can go out.

That does not mean being the best in the room at everything. It means being good enough across the board to move on your own, and then deliberately bringing in people who are better than you at specific things. Freelancers first, colleagues later. A motion designer who is stronger than you are. An illustrator with a hand you do not have.

What stays with you either way is the judgment: what goes out, what does not, and why.

what you will do

Own how mika sounds and looks everywhere: ads, landing pages, website, social, video, decks, events

Write and make. Headlines, ad copy, page copy, campaign concepts, and the visuals that carry them.

Make a dry subject genuinely good. Boring is a choice, not a property of the material.

Hold the standard for everything the company publishes, including work made elsewhere in the team or bought outside

Build the system: components, templates and copy patterns, so good work does not depend on you being in the room

Build the bench. Bring or find the freelancers, brief them properly, and judge what comes back.

Own our visual identity refresh, across brand and the product surfaces

Requirements

what you bring to the table

AI-native, and able to judge what comes out of it.
Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner. Generating is the easy part here: the value is that you can look at ten outputs and know which one is right and why. That judgment is what we are actually hiring.

Words and images from the same person.
Show us work where you wrote the copy as well as made the piece.

Solid fundamentals on both sides: type, layout, hierarchy and restraint, and a voice that sounds like a person rather than a brand guideline

You have made a dry or technical subject feel good, not just look tidy

Brand work and performance work in the same career

A network of freelancers you can pull on
: motion, design, illustration, video, content. A strong plus, and the thing that makes a small team look bigger than it is.

You can take a weak asset apart on the spot and say what is wrong with it, in the copy and in the layout

the level we are hiring at

Senior enough that nobody needs to brief you on what good looks like. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves.

We are not hiring a head of brand above you. The intention is that this role becomes it as the team grows.

nice to have

A rebrand or identity refresh you carried through to implementation. Motion and video craft. Product and UX design alongside brand. Fintech, tax, insurance or another category where trust has to be designed. Webflow.

German at C2 or above is required.
You are writing the copy, and in this market whether a line lands cannot be judged in translation. English at B2 or above, since it is our working language.

Benefits

Base 65,000 to 90,000 EUR depending on experience, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

You decide how mika looks and sounds.
Not inside a style guide somebody else wrote. You write the guide.

Room, and the expectation that you use it.
We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.

A category nobody has built.
There is no established visual or verbal language for what we are, which means the one you make becomes it.

A path into leading brand
, if you want it

Founders in the detail with you
, and no layer between you and a decision

Work that matters outside the building.
Every customer we win gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork, and how we come across is a large part of why they trust us enough to switch.

Send us your portfolio and point us at one piece where you wrote the copy as well as designed it.

At mika, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive. Join us in building the future of small business finance!

jobs.title: Brand and Creative Lead
jobs.description:
On a mission

At DeltaQuad, you’ll work on technology that truly matters. As a pioneer in long-range electric VTOL drones (Vertical Take-Off and Landing), we develop robust systems in collaboration with trusted partners, which are deployed across the globe for defence, agriculture and inspection. Our drones are reliable, user-friendly, and built to perform in demanding environments.

We combine technical innovation with a pragmatic mindset. What we do today shapes where we’ll be tomorrow, and you’ll play a crucial role in that journey.

Our core values

Partnerships
– Growing together through long-term collaboration
Customer focus
– Thinking and acting with the customer in mind
Ownership
– Taking responsibility for what we do
Innovation
– Finding smart, practical solutions
Excellence
– Focused on quality and results
Team spirit
– Building trust, growth, and enjoyment together

The role

The Brand & Creative Lead is responsible for translating DeltaQuad’s mission, corporate positioning and communication strategy into clear creative direction, concepts, formats and high-quality brand output.

Operating at the intersection of advanced technology, defence and security, you will help shape how DeltaQuad presents its brand, products and capabilities to government and defence customers, international partners, industry stakeholders, investors and other professional audiences.

This is a different creative challenge from traditional consumer or retail branding. Our audiences are highly informed, our products are technically complex and credibility matters. You need to understand what makes a sophisticated product relevant to a B2B audience and turn technical capabilities into communication that is clear, distinctive and compelling without losing substance or accuracy.

You will contribute to the development of our brand strategy and take the lead in bringing that strategy to life creatively. From defining the visual direction for a product launch or industry event to improving our brand templates or briefing a freelance designer, you make sure our creative output is distinctive, consistent, credible and professionally executed.

This is a hands-on creative role, combining strategic and conceptual thinking with practical execution and creative production leadership.

Key responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Direction:
Help develop our brand strategy and translate our mission, positioning and messaging into clear and distinctive creative direction.
Creative Concepts & Execution:
Develop concepts, formats and assets for campaigns, product launches, market entries, industry events and employer branding.
Brand Consistency:
Own and strengthen brand consistency across our marketing and communication channels.
Product Storytelling:
Work with Product and technical teams to understand complex technology and turn technical capabilities, features and use cases into clear, accurate and visually compelling stories for specialist and B2B audiences.
Creative Leadership:
Brief and guide freelance designers, agencies and other creative partners while remaining hands-on where needed.
Creative Operations:
Improve guidelines, templates, workflows and production processes to raise quality and make creative output more scalable.

What you bring

B2B Brand & Creative Experience:
Strong experience in branding, creative direction or visual communication within a B2B environment. You understand how to communicate to professional audiences and decision-makers, where credibility, clarity and substance are central to the brand.
Technology or Industry Experience:
Experience working with technology, engineering, aerospace, defence, robotics, industrial products or another complex technical offering is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable getting into the detail of a product to understand what you are communicating.
Strong Portfolio:
A portfolio demonstrating strong brand thinking and creative concepts within a B2B, technology or product-led environment, and their consistent application across different formats and channels.
Technical Storytelling:
You can take complex technical information and turn it into communication that is understandable and engaging while retaining the accuracy and substance expected by knowledgeable audiences.
Strategic + Hands-on:
Able to translate brand and communication strategy into creative work and comfortable executing ideas yourself.
Creative Leadership:
Experience directing designers, freelancers, agencies or other creative specialists.
Stakeholder Skills:
Able to work effectively with Product, Marketing, Engineering and other technical stakeholders and turn complex input into strong creative output.
Quality & Ownership:
A sharp eye for detail, high creative standards and the ability to manage multiple projects from concept through delivery.
Professional fluency in English is required.

Who you are

You have a strong creative point of view without becoming precious about your ideas. You can explain why something works, challenge work that isn’t strong enough and translate feedback from different stakeholders into a better creative outcome.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where not everything is already defined. Rather than simply maintaining an established brand system, you enjoy helping build and improve one.
You are genuinely interested in technology and complex products. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you are curious enough to ask the right questions, understand what makes a product technically and commercially relevant and turn that into a strong story.\

You understand that B2B technology branding requires a different approach from consumer branding. The audience may include engineers, defence professionals, government stakeholders, procurement teams, partners and other industry specialists. You know how to create work that gets their attention while still feeling credible, intelligent and appropriate for the environment we’re operating in.

You bring sound judgement about how to present complex information, balancing creative ambition with technical accuracy, audience expectations and organisational sensitivities.
Most importantly, you know how to balance creativity with clarity. Our products are highly technical and operate in serious environments, so the strongest creative work isn’t necessarily the loudest. It makes complex technology understandable, builds credibility and gives DeltaQuad a distinctive and consistent identity.

What we offer

Coaching and professional growth opportunities
27 vacation days (based on full-time)

jobs.description:
Merhabalar,

Uğradığın için teşekkürler.İş aramanın ne kadar vakit aldığını biliyoruz.Ne teklif ettiğimizi merak ediyorsundur,o yüzden direkt konuya giriyoruz.

Hitup kimdir?

HITUP®, adını "hitap etmek"ten alıyor ve işimiz de tam olarak bu: doğru insana, doğru dille seslenmek. Sokak kültüründen beslenen, kaliteyi merkeze alan bir erkek streetwear markasıyız. Ürünlerimizin, giyen kişinin kendi hikâyesinin bir uzantısı olmasını istiyoruz.

18–34 yaş arası erkeklere hitup.com.tr ve Trendyol üzerinden satış yapıyoruz. Biz buna "hitup etmek" diyoruz. Arayacağın kişi, kime, hangi açıdan ve hangi formatta hitup edeceğimize veriyle karar verecek.
Küçük ama hızlı bir ekibiz. Sisteme dayalı çalışıyoruz: test ediyor, ölçüyor ve kazananı büyütüyoruz.

Nerede ve nasıl çalışacaksın?

Bu pozisyon İstanbul Bağcılar'daki ofisimizde, yerinde çalışma şeklinde. Ürünün, çekimin ve ekibin bir arada olduğu yerdesin. Kumaşa dokunabilir, çekime girebilir, fikrini aynı gün test edebilirsin.
Pozisyon 6–12 ay arası sözleşmeli. Sonuç getiren arkadaşlarla yolumuza uzun vadede devam etmek istiyoruz.

Rol hakkında

Hitup'un kreatif performans motoru sen olacaksın. Ücretli ve organik pazarlamamızda veri, hikâye anlatımı ve sokak kültürünün kesiştiği noktada çalışacaksın. Hedef, gerçek büyüme sağlamak. Bu bir "brief yaz, bekle" rolü değil. Fikri sen üretecek, test ettirecek, sonucu okuyacak ve bir sonraki turu sen kuracaksın.

Neler yapacaksın?

Kreatif döngüyü yöneteceksin.
Araştırma, brief, çekim, kurgu ve analiz. Tüm döngü senin sorumluluğunda. Haftalık sprintler halinde, kullanıcı içgörüsüne dayanan ve test edilebilir fikirler üreteceksin.

Kreatif çeşitliliği sistemleştireceksin.
Personadan açıya, açıdan mesaja, mesajdan formata kadar her yapı taşını ayrı ayrı test edilebilir hale getireceksin. Hook, UGC, talking head, ürün odaklı, lifestyle, carousel, static gibi her formatta neyin, kime ve neden çalıştığını bileceksin.

Performansı analiz edip optimize edeceksin.
Meta ve TikTok panellerine dalıp kazananları bulacak, düşen kreatiflerin neden düştüğünü teşhis edecek, yeni test tasarımları kuracaksın.

Organik ve ücretli sosyal stratejiyi yöneteceksin.
Meta, Instagram, TikTok ve yükselen platformlarda Türk erkek kitlesi için yüksek performanslı içeriğin nasıl göründüğünü tanımlayacaksın. Trendleri ve kültürel anları yakalayacaksın.

UGC ve içerik üreticileriyle çalışacaksın.
Creator brief'lerini yazacak, gelen içerikleri marka ve platform diline uygunluk açısından değerlendireceksin.

Dönüşümü destekleyeceksin.
Reklamdan ürün sayfasına, sepete kadar olan yolculuğu iyileştirecek CRO çalışmalarına katkı sağlayacaksın. Web sitesi ve Trendyol tarafındaki dönüşüm de senin ilgi alanında olacak.

Aradığımız kişi

Kreatif strateji veya performans pazarlamasında gerçek, elle tutulur deneyimin var. Performans getiren kreatifin nasıl kurulduğunu biliyorsun. Platformun doğal dilini iyi anlıyorsun, test konusunda disiplinlisin ve veriyi düşünceni keskinleştirmek için kullanıyorsun, onun yerine koymak için değil. Türk gençlik ve sokak kültürünü yüzeysel değil, içeriden tanıyorsun. Kendi başına yön bulabiliyor ve sonucun sahipliğini alıyorsun.

Muhtemelen tam aradığımız kişisin, eğer:

Moda, streetwear, tekstil veya e-ticaret alanında kreatif strateji ya da growth marketing deneyimin varsa ve bu deneyimi referans ve gerçek kampanya sonuçlarıyla gösterebiliyorsan

Persona, açı, mesaj, hook ve format katmanlarına hakimsen ve kreatif çeşitliliği tesadüfe değil, sisteme dayandırıyorsan
Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads ve analitik araçlarla rahat çalışıyorsan; ROAS, CPA, CTR, hook rate gibi metriklerden karar çıkarabiliyorsan
Brief yazmayı, kurgu yönlendirmeyi ve hızlı iterasyon yapmayı biliyorsan
Belirsizlikten korkmuyor, merak ediyor ve test ederek öğreniyorsan

Başvururken lütfen şunları ekle:

CV'n.
Portföyün veya çalıştığın kreatif örnekler (performans verisiyle birlikte olursa çok daha iyi)
Referans verebileceğin en az bir marka veya yönetici
Kısa bir not: "Hitup'un bugünkü içeriğine baksan, ilk test edeceğin 3 fikir ne olurdu?"

Bilmen gereken diğer şeyler

İşe alım kararlarımızı deneyimine, becerilerine ve tutkuna göre veriyoruz. Ayrıca Hitup'a ve ekip kültürüne neler katabileceğine de bakıyoruz.
Listedeki maddelerin hiçbirini karşılamıyor ama kendine güveniyorsan, yine de yaz. Bize neden senin bu işi yapabileceğini anlatan kısa bir not ekle. Portföyün yoksa, kendi başına ürettiğin içerikler ya da yönettiğin bir hesap da olur.

Company Description

Within Publicis Groupe's Intelligent Creativity business, Publicis Production specializes in bringing creative ideas to life, and to consumers.

Our 6,000-strong talent across 52 locations worldwide radically redefine content production by delivering Intelligent Content. Together, they leverage a 100-year history of craft excellence, the world's biggest studio network, and the industry's richest data through the power of agentic AI. Intuitively delivering through the world's first Intelligent Content agent, Marcel Make.

The result? A production company that leads the way. A category-defining promise to the market with predictively performing content that unlocks unprecedented business growth. And a workplace with countless opportunities, at the forefront of innovation, AI and award-winning craft.

Overview

We’re building a new AI capability to respond to client briefs across advertising, production, and post-production, and we’re looking for an AI Artist
to help deliver it.

This role is ideal for a hands-on AI practitioner with strong operator skills who can work across fast-moving briefs, build and refine outputs, and contribute confidently within a growing team structure.

Working closely with the AI Artist Lead and Creative Director, you’ll help translate briefs into executable AI workflows, create and iterate assets, and support delivery across projects while working within real-world production timelines and quality expectations.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You’ll spend the majority of your time in the tools, making, refining, testing, and troubleshooting work across a range of AI-driven production tasks.

Responsibilities

Deliver AI Work Across Live Projects

Create and iterate AI-driven outputs across video, visual, and audio workflows
Translate briefs and feedback into practical prompt, workflow, and edit iterations
Support delivery across multiple projects with different timelines and levels of complexity
Help maintain quality, consistency, and reliability across outputs

Work Within an AI Project Team

Work closely with the AI Artist Lead, Creative Director of AI, and other team members on active briefs
Respond positively to direction, feedback, and changing creative requirements
Share learning, problem-solving approaches, and workflow knowledge with the wider team
Collaborate effectively with freelance and in-house specialists as project needs evolve

Stay Hands-On in the Tools

Build, refine, and troubleshoot AI workflows across video, visual, and audio generation
Test different models, approaches, and settings to achieve the best output for the brief
Work across adjacent tools where needed, including edit, compositing, or workflow support tasks

Help Build the AI Capability

Contribute to improving workflows, best practices, and QA consistency
Surface tool insights, workflow issues, and practical learnings from delivery
Support the team in building repeatable and scalable ways of working

Qualifications

Essential Experience

Experience as an AI artist, creative technologist, or similar hands-on role
Background in agency, production, or post-production environments is preferred
Clear understanding of real-world production workflows, approvals, and deadlines
Ability to work independently on defined tasks while collaborating closely with leads and wider teams
Comfortable taking feedback and iterating quickly under time pressure

AI & Creative Skillset

Hands-on experience with generative AI tools for video, audio, and visual creation
Strong working knowledge of tools such as:
Frontier generative video models (e.g. Veo / Runway / Kling / Sora-class)
Generative audio tools (e.g. ElevenLabs or equivalent)
LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
ComfyUI
Node-based workflows and adjacent AI tooling
Solid video editing literacy (Premiere, Resolve, or equivalent)
Understanding of CGI / 3D workflows (literacy rather than deep specialism)
Strong creative judgement, taste, and storytelling instinct

Mindset & Behaviour

Builder mentality, motivated by making and improving the work
Proactive, organised, and solutions-driven
Curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning in a fast-moving space
Cares deeply about craft, speed, experimentation, and quality
Calm under pressure and open to feedback

Diversity and inclusion is a core part of who we are at Publicis Production. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture that encourages, celebrates and supports our wonderfully diverse employee group – whatever their age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability or ethnicity. Diversity and inclusion doesn’t just fuel our creativity and innovation, it brings us closer to our people and audiences. We will continue to strive to create a culture and environment where everyone feels empowered and more importantly comfortable enough to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for employees with disabilities and for candidates in our application process. jobs.title: Creative Performance Lead
jobs.description:
THE MANDATE

Peggy is building a category-defining AI assistant for parents. Our growth engine will be Meta (IG/FB) video ads, driven by high-velocity creative iteration.

Your job is not “run ads.”

Your job is to build a repeatable creative-performance system that turns raw video into profitable user acquisition - without breaking trust.

If you optimize vanity metrics, over-promise emotionally, or need a big team to function, this role is not for you.

WHAT YOU OWN (END-TO-END)

1. Meta Video Growth Engine (Primary)

  • Design and operate a video-first creative system for IG/FB

  • Turn raw UGC, screen recordings, and B-roll into:

    • 10–30 hook variations per concept

    • Multiple pacing and framing cuts

    • Emotionally distinct angles (stress → relief, chaos → calm, guilt → competence)

  • Separate idea testing from execution quality

  • Optimize for thumb-stop, retention, and conversion - not production value

2. Media Buying & Spend Discipline

  • Own Meta campaign structure, budgets, and kill criteria

  • Treat creative as the primary optimization lever

  • Operate confidently in a post-iOS14 / SKAN-imperfect world

WHAT YOU DO NOT OWN

jobs.title: Generative AI Artist
jobs.description:
Portfolio first:
apply via https://wolfstreet.nl/job/ai-artist/ or include a link to your portfolio or showreel in your application. Applications without a link will not be considered. You must be based in the Netherlands.

Who are we?

Wolfstreet is an Amsterdam-based creative and production agency specialized in visual content. We build campaigns and content for brands and agencies by combining what we do in-house: creative development, production and post-production. We work for brands like Vinted, Picnic, BUX, Stëlz and Mastercard.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for a Generative AI Artist with real taste and the technical skills to back it up, to join our in-house AI studio.
You sit somewhere between art director and technician. You know how to get exactly the image you have in mind out of a model, and you know when something isn’t good enough yet. You work closely with our post team on shots that need to hold up in a campaign, and just as closely with our creatives while ideas are still taking shape - from look development and moodfilms to final, production-ready output.
You combine a strong eye with a solid VFX foundation, so your work doesn’t stop at a nice generation: you make it fit, match and hold up in the final edit.

Taste first, tools second

Anyone can generate an image. What we’re after is someone who knows what makes an image right: composition, light, texture and consistency across a whole campaign. The tools change every month, taste and judgement don’t.
That’s why your portfolio is leading for us. Show us the work you’re proud of, and tell us how you made it.

What you’ll do

Develop looks, styleframes and visual concepts together with our creatives
Create production-ready AI imagery and video for campaigns, social and branded content
Build and maintain node-based workflows (e.g. ComfyUI) for consistent, controllable results
Work hand in hand with our online artists and editors to integrate AI shots into the final film
Take care of the 2D side yourself where needed: compositing, clean-up, keying and matching
Keep track of new models and tools, test what’s worth it and help shape how we use AI at Wolfstreet

You

Have a portfolio that shows both strong taste and technical control - your portfolio is leading in our selection
Are an exceptional prompter who gets consistent, art-directed results instead of lucky shots
Know the current generative image and video tools inside out, and can build your own node setups
Have solid VFX basics: 2D compositing, clean-up, keying and a good understanding of how shots come together in post
Think like an art director, with a clear point of view on look, style and quality
Enjoy working with both post-production and creative teams, and communicate clearly
Speak fluent English (Dutch is not required) and live in the Netherlands

What we offer

€3,750 - €4,250 gross per month (excl. 8% holiday allowance), depending on experience
A 32 to 40 hour week, whichever suits you best
Ownership over your role and real creative freedom
Campaigns for big (inter)national brands
Pension scheme

jobs.title: Senior Strategist, Creative Strategy
jobs.description:
Karla Otto is a globally recognized public relations and communications agency, founded in 1982, with offices in 15 key cities across the UK, EMEA, US, and Asia. With a strong presence in fashion capitals such as Milan, London, Paris, and New York, the agency has built a reputation for representing some of the most prestigious names in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

In 2017, Karla Otto merged with K2 to form THE INDEPENDENTS, a global marketing, design, and communications group. This collective brings together industry leaders who share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and thoughtful collaboration across the luxury and lifestyle sectors.

At Karla Otto, our team of expert strategists, designers, planners and publicists are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and establishing long-term partnerships with our clients. We are passionate about the world of fashion, beauty, and luxury, with everyone bringing their unique expertise and insights to the table. We are driven by a shared commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the ever-evolving industry landscape.

The Senior Strategist is a senior member of Karla Otto’s Creative Strategy division, working across UK client teams, selected global clients and new business. The role combines creative strategy, cultural insight and concept development across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, hospitality and FMCG.

Working closely with the Creative Strategy leadership team, the Senior Strategist translates strategic direction into clear, compelling ideas and platforms across campaigns, content, experiences and programming. They will lead client briefs and presentations, develop creative-led work and contribute to new business and the continued growth of the Creative Strategy offer.

Cultural fluency is central to the role. The Senior Strategist brings a strong understanding of the creative and cultural landscape, alongside the network and judgement to identify relevant talent, creators, partners and collaborators and translate emerging cultural shifts into original, future-facing ideas.

This is a senior, client-facing role for an ideas-led creative with strong conceptual judgement, cultural intelligence and an active industry network. The role also offers opportunities to develop commercial and team leadership skills, with scope to progress to Director based on demonstrated readiness.

Key Responsibilities

CREATIVE

Lead creative strategy and concept development on assigned UK client briefs, from identifying the opportunity through to campaigns, content, experiences and programming, alongside selected global clients and pitches.
Translate cultural and creative shifts into original thinking for client work and new business.
Lead the creative direction and quality of assigned work, aligning with the Director on strategic direction and the SVP on departmental standards.
Develop the strategic foundation for creative-led briefs and partner with the Director where broader brand or business strategy is required.
Identify and shape experience-led and Insights-led opportunities in partnership with Special Projects and Insights respectively.
Identify and recommend talent, creators, partners and collaborators, working with the Talent team where relevant.
Lead client conversations, presenting and defending strategic and creative recommendations and identifying opportunities to develop the work.

NEW BUSINESS & GROWTH

Lead the creative response on assigned UK and relevant global pitches, with strategic and commercial guidance from the Director and SVP.
Identify opportunities across existing clients and new prospects, and develop and sell Creative Strategy work alongside the senior team.
Build integrated proposals with Insights, Communications, Talent, Beauty, Strategy, Special Projects and other divisions.
Contribute to scoping and pricing, accounting for resourcing, production requirements and profitability, with final commercial approval from the senior team.

TEAM & DIVISION DEVELOPMENT

Coordinate workflow and delivery on assigned briefs, identify resource needs and flag scope or budget pressures to the Director and SVP.
Guide colleagues and external collaborators, giving clear creative feedback and supporting the development of junior team members.
Maintain and grow the external creative network required to deliver work at the right standard.

KEY ATTRIBUTES

6–8 years’ experience in creative strategy, creative direction or an equivalent agency role, with a focus on social and digital channels, programming and experiential work.
A strong portfolio spanning campaigns, content, experiences, programming and brand platforms.
Strong creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking, with a highly developed visual eye and excellent art direction judgement.
Deep reference knowledge across fashion, art, design, music, film and photography, with the instinct to spot what is emerging, anticipate where culture is moving and translate this into original creative thinking.
An active network across talent, creators and the wider creative industries, with a strong understanding of who and what is shaping culture now and next.
Ability to translate strategy into clear, compelling creative ideas, communicate them through strong writing, visual storytelling and presentations, and guide their execution within agreed budgets.
Strong knowledge of creative platforms, partners and production models, including how to commission, brief, scope and price creative work.
Proven ability to present, sell and defend creative work.
Able to move quickly across multiple briefs while maintaining a high creative standard and adapting to different senior stakeholders and working styles.
Experience leading creative and project teams, directing external collaborators and giving clear creative feedback.
Naturally curious and eager to learn, keeping pace with industry changes and exploring how emerging tools and technologies, including AI, can strengthen creative thinking and open up new opportunities for clients.
Strong proficiency in Keynote; working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite advantageous.
Commercial awareness and experience working with budgets, resources and delivery processes, with the ambition to develop broader leadership responsibility.

At Karla Otto, we are always looking for personalities with positive charisma who are enthusiastic, self-motivated, and have a keen sense of aesthetics.

Karla Otto embraces and celebrates diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Karla Otto provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join our team!

Founded in 1982, Karla Otto is a full-service brand-building agency specialising in fashion, design, beauty, lifestyle, arts and culture, operating from fifteen cities across the globe.

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Creative Strategist/Art
Overview  

  

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward\-thinking, on\-brand content solutions and campaigns that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.  

  

As a Sr Creative Art based in Milan, you will shape the creative thinking and designs behind our work for the Italian market \- turning client business challenges into sharp strategic platforms and bringing them creatively to life as ideas that can be seen, not just read. You will relish a fast\-paced environment, juggle multiple deliverables, and be equally comfortable defending a strategic rationale and sketching out how the idea should look and feel.  

  

The Role  

  

* Translate client briefs and market insight into compelling creative strategies and campaign platforms for the Italian market, with occasional work across wider Europe


\- Develop holistic, memorable campaigns from initial concept through to execution \- Working closely with Creative Desk Project Managers, Art Directors and Copywriters to ensure end\-to\-end development and delivery of campaigns for assigned customers.
  

* Maintain quality, accuracy and consistency of content and design across all mediums to best industry practice standards and client branding guidelines by ensuring all output is checked and errors minimised.
* Overall responsibility for the production of communications material on time and to budget.
* Bring strong conceptual skills and a highly developed ability to express those concepts across a continuously evolving set of channels
* Craft short and long form copy in Italian and English for marketing purposes, including direct response designed to drive action and conversion
* Think visually: shape look, feel, layout and tone alongside designers and art directors, and communicate ideas through sketches, mood boards, storyboards or scrappy mock\-ups where words alone won't land


\- Execute across a wide array of channels including TV, online video, online banners, social platforms, and print \- always to the highest standards of craft  

* Present work concisely in internal reviews and client meetings, in both Italian and English
* Be proactive in bringing ideas that solve client challenges and grow the business

  

All About You  

  

* Native or fully fluent Italian, with proven experience building creative work for the Italian market and a genuine feel for its culture, media landscape and consumer behaviour


\- Fluent business English \- you will work daily with colleagues and clients across Europe  

* Experience developing creative strategy and concepts within a creative agency environment or client\-side marketing team
* Ability to concept new campaigns across a variety of mediums, digital\-first
* Ability to combine conceptual creative thinking with high\-quality delivery


\- A strong visual instinct \- you have a point of view on design, typography and imagery  

* Ability to interpret brand and style guidelines from various clients and apply them consistently across marketing collateral
* Ability to interpret creative briefing documents and translate them into compelling, on\-strategy work
* Captivating presentation skills
* Passionate about social platforms, trends, technology and best practices
* Excellent organizational and communication skills

  

A plus:  

  

* International or multi\-market campaign experience
* Experience in financial institutions, banking, payments or wider FI industries
* Creative agency background
* A solid understanding of the customer journey as it relates to card and banking (acquisition, conversion, activation, early month on books, customer loyalty, cross\-sell)


\- A portfolio that shows both the thinking and the making \- strategy decks alongside work you helped shape visually  

  

Gross annual salary base range: 45,000 \- 72,000 EUR**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) bei bamtoo in Berlin
jobs.description:
Wir suchen einen Creative Strategist – Performance Marketing (m/w/d)
für unser Team bei bamtoo®
in Berlin in Vollzeit (40 h / Woche).

bamtoo ist eine Zahnpflege-Marke aus Berlin und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Startups der Branche im DACH-Raum. Wir bauen Zahnpflegeprodukte, die ressourcenschonende Materialien mit moderner Technologie kombinieren. Denn wir glauben, dass man für das eine nicht auf das andere verzichten sollte. Und mehr als 100.000 Kund:innen sehen das offenbar genauso.

Wir suchen jemanden, der versteht, warum Menschen kaufen - und dieses Verständnis in überzeugende Werbeanzeigen übersetzt. Du verbindest starke Ideen und gutes Copywriting mit einem klaren Blick auf Performance. Gemeinsam mit unserem Creative- und Performance-Team entwickelst du Anzeigen, die Aufmerksamkeit gewinnen, Vertrauen aufbauen und Menschen von unseren Produkten überzeugen.

Deine Aufgaben

Entwicklung von Creative-Konzepten für unsere Paid-Social-Kampagnen, insbesondere auf Meta und TikTok
Schreiben von Video-Skripten, Hooks, Headlines und Anzeigentexten – vom ersten Aufmerksamkeitspunkt bis zum überzeugenden Kaufargument
Copywriting für Landingpages und Funnel: Du entwickelst überzeugende Texte, die Kund:innen vom ersten Interesse bis zum Kauf führen – mit klaren Nutzenargumenten, gezielter Einwandbehandlung und starken Calls-to-Action.
Tiefgehende Recherche zu unseren Zielgruppen: Du analysierst Kundenbewertungen, Support-Anfragen und Wettbewerber, um Kaufmotive, Wünsche und Einwände zu verstehen
Übersetzung von Produkteigenschaften in relevante Kundenvorteile und klare, glaubwürdige Werbebotschaften
Erstellung konkreter Briefings für Video Editor:innen, Designer:innen und UGC-Creator:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung
Analyse der Creative-Performance gemeinsam mit dem Media Buying & Head of Creative: Was funktioniert, warum funktioniert es und was testen wir als Nächstes?
Systematische Weiterentwicklung erfolgreicher Anzeigen durch neue Einstiege, Botschaften, Formate und Storytelling-Ansätze
Aufbau einer strukturierten Creative-Testplanung mit klaren Hypothesen und dokumentierten Learnings
Abstimmung von Werbebotschaften mit unseren Angeboten und Landingpages für eine konsistente Customer Journey

Was wir suchen

Du schreibst nicht einfach Texte, die gut klingen. Du verstehst, welche Botschaft eine Zielgruppe in welcher Situation überzeugt. Dafür beschäftigst du dich intensiv mit dem Produkt, hörst Kund:innen zu und hinterfragst deine eigenen Ideen anhand von Ergebnissen.
Du kannst erklären, warum du einen bestimmten Hook testen möchtest, welche Annahme dahintersteckt und was du aus dem Ergebnis lernen willst. Dabei bringst du sowohl eigene Ideen als auch die nötige Struktur mit, um sie konsequent in die Umsetzung zu bringen.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

Praktische Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Performance Copywriting oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im E-Commerce oder Agenturumfeld
Sehr gutes Copywriting für Anzeigen, Landingpages und Funnel: Du formulierst präzise, schreibst starke Einstiege und baust überzeugende Argumentationen auf, die zum Kauf motivieren.
Ein tiefes Marketingverständnis - insbesondere für Kaufpsychologie, Zielgruppenbewusstsein, Positionierung, Angebotskommunikation und den Umgang mit Kaufeinwänden
Ein gutes Gespür für Storytelling, visuelle Kommunikation und die Besonderheiten von Social-Media-Werbung
Erfahrung mit unterschiedlichen Creative-Formaten wie UGC, Testimonials, Founder Ads, Produktdemonstrationen und Static Ads
Verständnis relevanter Performance-Kennzahlen und die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete nächste Tests abzuleiten
Einen strukturierten, eigenständigen Arbeitsstil und Freude an schneller Umsetzung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung
Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch
Einen sicheren Umgang mit digitalen Tools und einen sinnvollen Einsatz von KI für Recherche, Ideenentwicklung und Textvarianten

Erfahrung mit physischen Konsumgütern ist ein Plus. Entscheidend ist, dass du Kundenverständnis, überzeugende Kommunikation und messbare Ergebnisse zusammenbringst.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und einem 9-köpfigen Creative- und Performance-Team
Die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Ideen unmittelbar zum Wachstum von bamtoo beizutragen
Ein relevantes Werbebudget und die Möglichkeit, neue Konzepte regelmäßig zu testen
Deine Skripte werden von Video Cuttern & Grafikdesignern direkt umgesetzt
Zugang zu Performance-Daten und direktem Kundenfeedback, damit du fundierte Entscheidungen treffen kannst
Eigenständige Verantwortung von der Recherche über das Konzept bis zur Auswertung
Kurze Entscheidungswege und wenig Konzern-Bürokratie
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung Senior Creative Strategist
Firmenbenefits wie Firmenfitness & Team-Events
Modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte
Ein ambitioniertes Team mit hohen Wachstumszielen

Uns ist weniger wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, tief in Zielgruppen und Produkte eintauchst und aus Erkenntnissen überzeugende Creatives entwickelst.

Interesse?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar kurze Sätze dazu, warum die Rolle zu dir passt. Zeig uns gerne zwei bis drei Anzeigen, Skripte oder Kampagnen, an denen du gearbeitet hast – inklusive deiner Rolle, der Idee dahinter und, falls verfügbar, der Ergebnisse.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist (AI)
jobs.description:
Creative Technologist (AI)

Build Halt · [London / on-site] · Full-time

Hi. We're looking for someone who can't stop building things.

You know the type. You get an idea on a Tuesday night, and by Wednesday morning there's a rough prototype, three new ideas off the back of it, and a tab open to a model that was released yesterday. If that sounds like you, keep reading.

We're Build Halt. We're small, we move fast, and we think the most interesting creative work of the next decade will come from people who think in ideas and build with AI. We're after one of those people.

This isn't a "here's your brief" job.

You'll come up with ideas, pull them apart, rebuild them better, and take them all the way to something real. We want your mind to shape where this goes: what we make, how we make it, and what we try next.

What your days might look like

Turning a half-formed idea into a working prototype before lunch
Chaining models, tools and agents in ways the docs never mentioned
Running experiments that might fail spectacularly, and telling us what you learned
Spotting what's coming next in AI before it's on everyone's feed
Taking the ideas that work and turning them into things people use, love and talk about
Having real say in the big decisions, not just the creative ones

You'll probably…

Speak fluent AI: LLMs, diffusion, agents, prompting, fine-tuning, APIs. You know what's under the hood and what's hype
Have a creative instinct you trust and the taste to back it up
Take risks, and be comfortable when an experiment doesn't work
Build things yourself, whether that's code, no-code, node graphs or duct tape
Have a folder of side projects nobody asked you to make
Care as much about why something should exist as about how to make it

Bonus points if you…

Have shipped something with AI that real people used
Write, share or teach what you're discovering
Have a slightly unhinged idea you've been waiting for someone to back

What you get

Creative freedom. We mean it
Salary and equity options negotiable
A generous budget for tools, models and compute. Break things, then make better things
A small team that will get excited about your weird ideas, not shut them down

How to apply

Skip the cover letter. Show us something you've built, anything from a polished product to a scrappy experiment, and tell us in a few lines what you'd build first if you joined. Send it to admin@buildhalt.com .
We welcome people from every background, especially those who didn't take the usual route. Different minds make better ideas.

Wir bieten

Onboarding zum Ankommen.

Arbeitszeit und -ort? Flexibel.

Miteinander und Kultur? Auf Augenhöhe.
Offenes Feedback. Regelmäßige Updates durch unsere Geschäftsführung. Lösungsorientiertes An-einem-Strang-Ziehen. Und natürlich auch Get-together-Events wie das Kartfahren, die EPG-Weihnachtsfeier oder unsere LAN-Party - um uns und unsere Erfolge zu feiern.
Jetzt. Für später.
Die betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) bietet eine gute Möglichkeit, für das Alter vorzusorgen. Dafür gibt es von uns im Heute einen starken Arbeitgeberzuschuss, damit Ihr Morgen so entspannt wie möglich wird.
Bewegung. Um lange bewegen zu können.
Jeder hat die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu leasen. Oder in unserem Sportraum zu trainieren. Lieber was im Team? Dann bietet sich der Firmenlauf oder ein Nachmittag im Kletterwald an.
Branche der Gegenwart. Und Zukunft.
Die Welt der Logistik begleitet nicht nur unser aller Alltag. Sie ist auch essenziell für eine nachhaltige, lebenswerte Zukunft. Was das bedeutet? Viel, was wir gemeinsam bewegen können. Die Möglichkeit, Dinge besser zu machen. Und einen sicheren, auch für die Zukunft relevanten, Arbeitsplatz.
Und klar, Obstkorb und Getränke haben wir natürlich auch.

Important note

Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla –
(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)
– A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

a briefek értelmezésétől a fő üzenetek és kreatív koncepció megalkotásán át a végrehajtható forgatókönyvig.

Szövegez: szlogeneket, manifesztókat, kampányüzeneteket, prezentációs narratívákat és ügyfél felé kommunikálható kreatív rationale-okat.
Szorosan együttműködik az account, PR és produkciós csapattal, és kreatív vezetőként irányt mutat a junior kollégáknak.

Amit elvárunk

Minimum 3 év ügynökségi tapasztalat kreatív stratégai, koncepciós vagy senior copywriter szerepkörben.

Tenderek, pitchek önálló építése – a stratégiai keret felállításától a prezentáció megírásáig.
Erős, eladható szövegalkotás magyar nyelven: rövid, üzenetorientált formátumokban és hosszabb stratégiai anyagokban egyaránt.
Magabiztos prezentációs készség ügyfél és belső csapat előtt. Magyar nyelv anyanyelvi szintű, angol nyelv magabiztos, tárgyalóképes ismerete.

Élmény- és rendezvénymarketing területen szerzett gyakorlat, márkaépítési projektekben szerzett tapasztalat, valamint jártasság a digitális és social-first kreatív formátumokban.

Amit kínálunk

Valódi kreatív szabadság és stratégiai döntési tér egy folyamatosan fejlődő ügynökségben.
Változatos ügyfélkör, ambiciózus projektek, és csapat, amelyik szereti, ha egy ötlet nem áll meg a koncepciónál.

jobs.title: AI Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
At 22DOGS, we are passionate about creating world\-class visual effects and fostering a collaborative, creative environment. With studios in Milan, Tenerife and Toronto, we bring together top\-tier talent and innovative workflows to deliver exceptional results for film, television, and advertising.
  

We are currently looking for talented Creative Technologists to join our growing team on an initial freelance, fully remote basis. This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to explore the intersection of art and technology, leveraging cutting\-edge AI and VFX tools to craft innovative visuals that push creative boundaries.
**Job Description**
The Creative Technologist leverages Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) to create, enhance, and integrate visual assets that support the creative vision of Clients and the Visual Effects Supervisor. The Technologist is responsible for the aesthetic integrity, technical reliability, and creative consistency of all AI\-generated imagery delivered for a task or project.
  

Under the guidance of the Head of Department, Department leads and Visual Effect Supervisors, the Creative Technologist produces high\-quality AI\-generated visual assets that meet the project’s creative direction, using a combination of AI\-driven tools, custom nodes and workflows, curated datasets, stills, animated imagery, CG renders, and digitally enhanced elements.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

* Generate high\-quality visuals and assets using AI\-driven tools and pipelines, including image generation, model prompting, fine\-tuning, dataset creation, upscaling, and iterative visual exploration.
* Collaborate with Head of Department, supervisors and artists across departments to create and integrate AI\-generated elements into final shots.
* Maintain visual consistency across assigned shots and sequences, ensuring style, colour, quality, and creative intent are aligned.
* Build, adapt, and optimize Generative AI workflows \- particularly within ComfyUI \- along with GenAI tools, and assist in identifying creative and technical solutions.
* Contribute to internal R\&D by testing emerging models, tools, and techniques and sharing findings with the wider team.
* Maintain high standards of visual quality, realism, and production readiness.
  

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**  

  

  

* Strong working knowledge of GenAI platforms and tools ( such as ComfyUI, image\-to\-image, image\-to\-video, video to video workflows, LoRA training and customization).
* Working knowledge of Compositing in Nuke on film or commercial projects.
* Strong artistic skills in composition, realism, style matching, lighting, and colour grading.
* Ability to work well under pressure, adapt quickly, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across departments.
  
  

**What We Offer**  

  

  

* Opportunity to work in a creative, international studio environment.
* Hands\-on experience and mentorship from an experienced HR team.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Supportive workplace culture focused on collaboration, growth, and innovation.
  
  

**Why Join Us?**
  

At 22DOGS, you’ll be part of an ambitious and international VFX studio where artistry and innovation meet. We value creativity, teamwork, and continuous learning — offering you the chance to grow your skills, lead exceptional artists, and help shape the future of visual storytelling.
  

**How to Apply**
  

If you’re passionate about VFX and ready to take the next step in your career, — we look forward to meeting you.

The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. The role will ensure order, efficiency and quality across the entire production chain, from material preparation to delivery to internal departments, up to the coordination of activities with external video/audio production and post-production partners.

You’ll work closely with your team to drive meaningful results and shape the way we work and grow .

Plan and manage production budgets, timelines, and relationships with internal teams and external suppliers, including creative agencies, photographers, videographers, and post-production partners, ensuring content aligns with marketing strategies.
Manage and oversee the day-to-day production of video content for web, social media, and in-store channels.

Collaborate closely with the internal Creative team, providing guidance, tools, and production support to deliver high-quality content while meeting tight deadlines.
Coordinate production schedules in line with the seasonal marketing calendar, ensuring timely execution of all deliverables.
Monitor project progress from pre-production through final delivery, ensuring raw assets are efficiently transformed into finished content within agreed timelines.
Develop creative production solutions and contribute innovative ideas to execute briefs effectively across both production and post-production phases.
Continuously research and evaluate new suppliers, directors, filmmakers, editors, emerging trends, technologies, and production techniques to drive innovation and maintain best-in-class creative standards.

Who You Are

You have University or bachelor’s degree.

Remuneration is determined on objective criteria, regardless of gender. Within the base salary range, individual pay is determined by knowledge, skills, experience, tenure and relevant education or training.

You will become part of an ongoing journey of development, uncovering your talents while contributing to a proud legacy and a vibrant tomorrow.

to lead our digital marketing and customer acquisition activities across global markets.

, combining strong in-house capabilities with selected external partners and agencies.

Identify priority markets, customer segments, acquisition channels, and new growth opportunities
Manage and optimize paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads
, and other relevant platforms
Continuously research and test new acquisition channels, platforms, technologies, and marketing opportunities

Monitor and optimize the full marketing funnel: Lead → KYC → First Deposit → Active Client

Work closely with CRM and Sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates
Develop and coordinate FTD's global social media and content marketing strategy
Manage web developers, designers, content teams, agencies, and other third-party marketing partners

Build and develop an effective in-house marketing capability
while managing specialized external partners where required
Quickly identify problems or bottlenecks and develop compliant alternative solutions when campaigns, platforms, or acquisition channels face restrictions
Establish clear marketing KPIs and provide weekly and monthly performance reporting to management
Continuously test and optimize campaigns, creatives, landing pages, audiences, funnels, and acquisition approaches
Turn data and market insights into actionable growth initiatives

in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, or Digital Marketing
Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads

Professional working proficiency in English
