jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™
and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.
Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.
Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.
Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.
Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.
Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.
Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.
Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.
Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.
Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.
Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.
Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.
Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).
Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What we offer

Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Du bist kreativ, konzeptstark und kommunikativ, kannst aber auch strategisch und analytisch arbeiten
Du arbeitest gern im Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für dich und deine Crew

Du bist bereit, Drehs vor Ort zu begleiten

jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design

Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Milan, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Milan hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the Italian market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.

About The Role

As the Creative Strategist for Italy, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region — working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.

What You'll Do

Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights
Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams
Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for Italian audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments
Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project
Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics
Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For

You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the Italian market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.

You're Probably a Match If

You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)
You have a strong eye for platform-native creative and the frameworks to test, learn, and scale it
You're confident using performance dashboards, data tools, and measurement frameworks (including MMM and attribution) to drive decisions
You have genuine, deep knowledge of the Italian market and are fluent in Italian and English - additional languages are a bonus
You have strong experience briefing and iterating creative in cross-functional sprints
You have a growth mindset — analytical, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

About The Group/Team

Our Europe Marketing Group drives market-specific growth across performance marketing, brand, social, community engagement, and more. We work at the intersection of creativity and data, combining global thinking with genuine local understanding to drive meaningful outcomes in our priority markets. We grow through experimentation, creative excellence, and a deep belief that getting the creative right is the fastest path to sustainable growth.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more details

Bei MyFitCoach bekommst du alles, was du brauchst, um aus guten Ideen erfolgreiche Performance Creatives zu entwickeln: maximale kreative Freiheit, moderne AI-Tools, schnelle Testing-Zyklen und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Ideen schnell getestet und weiterentwickelt werden.
Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden Startups, das Menschen weltweit mit einer intelligenten App dabei unterstützt, durch effektives Krafttraining fitter, gesünder und stärker zu werden.

Warum MyFitCoach?

Rund 100 % Wachstum pro Jahr in den letzten drei Jahren
Über 2 Millionen Downloads und und eine treue Community von +150.000 Nutzern
2023, 2024 & 2025 von Apple als „App des Tages“ ausgezeichnet
Kunden in über 160 Ländern

Diese Rolle ist genau richtig für dich, wenn...

du erfolgreiche Ads systematisch analysierst und genau verstehst, warum sie performen.
du ständig neue Hooks, Angles und Creative-Konzepte entwickelst.
du lieber neue Creatives testest, als lange über Ideen zu diskutieren.
du Daten genauso spannend findest wie Kreativität.
du AI selbstverständlich nutzt, um schneller bessere Creatives zu entwickeln.
du weißt, dass erfolgreiche Ads nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern vor allem performen müssen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du analysierst die Ad Libraries unserer Competitor und bestimmst, welche Konzepte wir für MyFitCoach adaptieren sollten.
Du versorgst unser zweiköpfiges Creative-Team laufend mit präzisen Briefings, leitest die Feedback-Schleife und stellst sicher, dass wir immer genug neue Creatives zum Testen haben.
Du koordinierst die Footage-Beschaffung und das Creator-Management, um fortlaufend starkes Rohmaterial für unsere Ad-Produktion zu sichern.
Du liest eigenständig die relevanten Creative-Metriken (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, ROAS, ...) im Ads Manager aus und findest heraus was funktioniert und warum es funktioniert.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast mind. 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Performance-/Paid-Social-Creative (Meta & TikTok & Google Ads), davon nachweislich mehrere von dir konzipierte Ads, die profitabel skaliert haben.
Du denkst in Metriken wie Hook Rate und Hold Rate statt in reiner Ästhetik.
Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und weißt, wie man Cutter steuert und weiterentwickelt.
Sicherer Umgang mit Paid Social Kanälen wie Meta Ads & TikTok Ads.
Exzellente Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Leidenschaft für Sport, Fitness und einen gesunden Lebensstil ist ein Plus.

Kein Problem. Wenn du glaubst, dass du hervorragend zu dieser Rolle passt und Motivation hast, in die Rolle rein zu wachsen, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das erwartet dich

100 % remote – arbeite dort, wo du am produktivsten bist.
Flache Hierarchien mit echter Verantwortung und Raum für deine Ideen.
Top-Equipment und modernste Tools für effizientes Arbeiten.

Ambitioniertes Team mit wertschätzender Kultur und regelmäßigen Events.
Unbefristeter Vertrag für langfristige Sicherheit.
Kostenloser Zugriff auf unsere App.

🎬 AI CREATIVE DIRECTOR — DESIGN & MOTION

Grupo Dani García · Equipo de Marketing
📍 Marbella · Reporta a CMO/CTO

✦ MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Impulsar la modernización del proceso de diseño y producción visual de la marca mediante la incorporación de inteligencia artificial generativa y herramientas digitales, y actuar como puente entre Diseño e IT/Web para agilizar la ejecución de piezas, prototipos y proyectos digitales.
Su misión es aplicar IA generativa de imagen y vídeo para elevar la calidad, consistencia y velocidad de producción de piezas gráficas y audiovisuales por igual: desde artes estáticos hasta Reels, TikTok, Stories y vídeo de campaña, alcanzando un nivel de calidad suficiente para sustituir o complementar producciones tradicionales (rodajes, alquiler de localizaciones, equipo de grabación) cuando el proyecto lo permita.

✦ RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

▸ Generación y edición con IA de piezas gráficas y audiovisuales: imagen, mockups, prototipado rápido, y vídeo para Reels, TikTok, Stories y campañas — desde el concepto hasta la pieza final.
▸ Aportar criterio de diseño y dirección visual a cada pieza generada con IA: composición, tipografía, color, ritmo y narrativa, adaptando el resultado a la identidad de marca definida por el equipo.
▸ Evaluar, seleccionar e implementar herramientas de IA generativa de imagen y vídeo (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Gemini y equivalentes) para producción gráfica y audiovisual.
▸ Postproducción, motion graphics, sonido y adaptación de formatos (vertical, cuadrado, distintas duraciones) para cada canal.
▸ Capacitar y acompañar al equipo en el uso de IA aplicada a producción creativa y audiovisual, sin resignar calidad de oficio.
▸ Construir y mantener flujos de trabajo que integren IA en la producción diaria: generación de variantes, prototipado rápido de conceptos antes de producción final.
▸ Medir y reportar ganancias de eficiencia (tiempos y costes de producción) derivadas de la adopción de IA, incluyendo casos de sustitución de rodajes tradicionales.
▸ Mantenerse a la vanguardia de nuevas herramientas de IA de imagen y vídeo relevantes para el sector, y proponer su incorporación.

✦ REQUISITOS

▸ Experiencia sólida en diseño gráfico/digital y dominio de herramientas de IA generativa (Midjourney, Runway, Gemini, Adobe Firefly, herramientas de vídeo/3D con IA, entre otras).

jobs.title: AI Video Creator (Based Onsite in Dubai)
jobs.description:
Own the AI video pipeline for a $1Billion+ brand. The media is already scaled — the constraint is creative that converts, on the feed and on the page.

Total Annual Package:
Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
Location:
Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support
Growth path
from here is Senior AI Video Creator → Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023:
In this role, tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney and Flux are part of the production workflow — not side experiments. AI gets you to footage faster; your judgment decides whether the hook works, the product looks real, the edit holds attention and the finished asset is ready to ship.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Video Creator, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. You will own AI video production across cold-traffic ads on Meta, TikTok and YouTube and product videos on Puffy.com, covering concept and script, image generation, motion, editing, compositing, colour and audio. This role exists to turn already-scaled media spend into creative that converts, building the production pipeline that carries a hook from script to shippable asset at volume without the craft slipping.

The Career Accelerator

You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.

The scope is scarce:
very few AI Video Creators get simultaneous ownership of video creative for both paid advertising and the product page. And a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.
Your first 12 months:
build the prompt and reference library for character and material consistency. Produce direct-response ads at volume for Meta and TikTok cold prospecting, multiple concepts per week. Solve character consistency across shots, including AI-generated spokespeople delivering to camera. Produce realism-first product video for Puffy.com from real product photography. Get material behaviour right — foam that compresses under a hand and recovers on release, fabric that moves like fabric. Master the invisible edit, blending generated footage with stock and shot footage until the AI elements are indistinguishable. Read CTR, hold rates and drop-off points and iterate the hook against what audiences actually do. Shape the future of AI video at Puffy, where creative is the binding constraint on a media engine that is already scaled.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Entire Chain, Script to Shipped Asset

You concept it, generate it, cut it, score it, and ship it.
You design the visual worlds, control the motion, cut for retention, and layer the voiceover, music and sound design — no handoff, no queue, no waiting on someone else's render. You choose which model solves which production problem, and you decide when footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production, and when the right call is to regenerate.
The standard is performance, not applause. Every asset is a hypothesis: with the broader marketing team, you review CTR, hold rates, drop-off points and on-page conversion, iterate the hook, and bring your cuts into review with the Director of Marketing.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Creator Whose Work Decides Whether It Converts

In most companies, video people make things that look good and hope somebody tests them. Here, you're the person whose first 3 seconds decide whether a cold audience stops scrolling, and whose product clip decides whether a shopper believes what's on screen is what arrives in the box. When an ad drives outbound CTR but not orders, your read on where it broke — hook, promise, or landing experience, is the reason the next iteration wins. You'll build the judgment to tell shippable generated footage from footage a shopper quietly distrusts and the direct-response instinct for where proof lands in a 30-second ad and where it kills the momentum. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency turnaround time in front of you.

What You'll Need

Direct response portfolio
— You've created ads designed to drive action, not just entertain. Performance results are valued where available.
Character consistency work
— You can maintain coherent characters, environments and visual details across multiple generated shots.
AI video generation fluency
— Hands-on experience with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar. You understand that different models solve different production problems.
Strong AI image-generation fundamentals
— Midjourney, Flux or similar tools for building controlled visual starting points and references.
Post-production expertise
— Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or similar. You're comfortable with compositing, colour grading, clean-up and upscaling.
Audio proficiency
— AI voice synthesis, music and sound design for performance creative.
Direct-response judgment
— You understand hooks, pacing, problem/solution structure, proof, offers and calls to action.
Production speed
— You can create and iterate multiple assets without treating every piece like a weeks-long production.
Quality judgment
— You know when generated footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production and when the right decision is to regenerate it.

Good-to-Have

DTC or e-commerce performance marketing experience
Ads with measurable conversion results
Familiarity with creative testing frameworks
Experience creating video specifically for e-commerce product pages or other on-site conversion journeys

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner:
We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency:
We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence:
We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First:
Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In:
When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits

💰 Compensation:

Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
Annual salary review every January
Tax-free income
Annual return flight allowance to your home country

Premium office environment in Dubai Internet City

International team collaboration, 16+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
bei JUNGLÜCK gibst du unserer Marke eine starke Stimme. Du tauchst tief in die Welt unserer Zielgruppe ein, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse, Träume und Zweifel und verwandelst diese Insights in ergebnisorientiertes und emotionales Storytelling für Ad Creatives, organischen Social-Content und Direct-Response-Landingpages mit Fokus auf Neukundenakquise.

Du verstehst, warum jemand in den ersten Sekunden eines Videos weiterschaut oder weiterscrollt, kennst die unterschiedlichen Ausgangslagen unserer Kundinnen – die 23-Jährige mit Unreinheiten, die 42-Jährige mit ersten Fältchen – und setzt konkrete Wirkmechanismen wie Hooks, Social Proof, Knappheit oder Preisanker gezielt ein. Am Ende stehen exzellente Copies, Skripte und Konzepte für Ads, Reels sowie Direct-Response-Landingpages.

Ad Angle-Backlog & Skripte: Du verantwortest den Angle-Backlog, welche Kaufmotivation wir ansprechen, mit welchem Argument, mit welcher Botschaft auf welcher Funnel-Stufe, in welchem Format und schreibst daraus Ad-Skripte in hoher Schlagzahl, die Viralität, Kaufmotive und Direct Response aktivieren und Einwände aushebeln, bevor sie überhaupt entstehen.
Organische Reichweite: Wir wollen unsere organische Reichweite in den nächsten 12 Monaten auf 2 Mio. Views/Monat ver-20-fachen. Du schreibst die Reel-Konzepte, die diese Reichweite erst ermöglichen und denkst dabei Paid und Organic von Anfang an zusammen
Trendscouting als Input für Konzepte: Du bist im Feed zuhause und beobachtest aktiv Format- und Trendentwicklungen auf TikTok, Instagram und Meta. Du übersetzt das frühzeitig in konkrete Angle- und Skript-Ideen, bringst dabei immer auch eigene kreative Ideen ein und arbeitest eng mit dem Influencer-Marketing-Team zusammen, um Trend-Insights und Learnings zwischen Ads/Organic und Creator-Content auszutauschen.
Testing & Diagnose: Du entwickelst und führst strukturierte Testing-Frameworks durch und liest anhand klarer KPIs direkt ab, wieso eine Ad, ein Reel oder eine Direct-Response-Landingpage (nicht) funktioniert. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, CAC und ihre Zusammenhänge fließen in deine Iterationen und neuen Konzepte ein.
Creative-Strategie & Produktion leiten: Du schreibst Briefings für UGC-Creator, Videografen und Editoren, die so präzise sind, dass ohne Rückfrage gearbeitet werden kann.
Skalierbare, KI-gestützte Workflows aufbauen und nutzen: Du nutzt KI Tools, die dein Iterationstempo und Volumen erhöhen, und bereicherst den Output im Anschluss mit deiner eigenen Handschrift.

Das steckt in deiner Haut

Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Creative Copywriter oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Performance Marketing, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld
Exzellentes Verständnis der psychologischen Trigger unserer Kundinnen und ihrer Kaufentscheidungen – ohne Psychologiestudium, aber mit der Fähigkeit, das in Copies, Skripte, Konzepte zu übersetzen
Ausgeprägtes Sprach- und Storytellinggefühl sowie hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Schreibe. Du nutzt KI-Tools als Tempo-Hebel, aber deine Texte sind niemals AI-Slop
Außergewöhnliches Gespür für kreative Werbekonzepte und virale Social-Media-Inhalte, für Paid wie für Organic
Tiefes Verständnis aktueller Trends auf TikTok, Instagram, Facebook und YouTube
Strategisches Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, kreative Prozesse und Schnittstellen effizient zu steuern
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
Sicherer Umgang mit Creative KPIs und Performance-Daten (u. a. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS, CAC)
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und schnelle Arbeitsweise
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

Deine Benefits: We care for you

Werde Teil eines aufgeschlossenen Teams mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Bei uns kannst du von Tag Eins an Verantwortung übernehmen und Deine eigenen Ideen vorantreiben
Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche sowie Umfragen, um das Arbeitsumfeld und die Unternehmenskultur stetig zu verbessern
Arbeite so, wie Du am produktivsten bist; profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, gelegentlich aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten
Bleibe aktiv! Bei uns erhältst Du eine Bezuschussung zu Deiner EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
Kümmere Dich um Dein mentales Wohlbefinden: Nutze die Möglichkeit Dir über OpenUp Online-Sitzungen mit ausgebildeten Psycholog*innen zu buchen sowie an zahlreichen Workshops und Webinaren teilzunehmen
Wir fördern den Teamspirit mit regelmäßigen Events und schaffen vielerlei Gelegenheiten zum Austausch untereinander
Natürlich gibt es bei uns auch einen Mitarbeiter*innen-Rabatt auf JUNGLÜCK-Produkte, außerdem erhältst Du Zugänge zu Plattformen, die Dir Vergünstigungen bei weiteren (nachhaltigen) Unternehmen bieten
Begleite uns auf unserer Mission, den Kosmetikmarkt nachhaltiger, transparenter und sozialer zu gestalten
Und das Beste: ein tolles Team, das Dich herzlich aufnimmt!

Kontakt

Konnten wir Dein Interesse wecken? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inkl. CV sowie der Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Startdatums und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Unser Interviewprozess:

Dich erwarten folgende Schritte:

Erstes Gespräch mit Jana, People & Culture (30-40 min)
Fachliches Interview mit Hannah, Head of Performance Marketing (45-60 min)
Bearbeitung einer Case Study zu Hause und anschließende Vorstellung der Ergebnisse (Präsentation ca. 45-60 min)
Teamkennenlernen mit zukünftigen Kolleg*innen (ca. 30 min)
Ein Angebot und Dein Vertrag warten auf Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Dein Onboarding!

Über uns

JUNGLÜCK ist 2018 aus einer persönlichen Beobachtung entstanden. Gründer Benedikt Klarmann sah, dass die Frauen in seinem Leben mit ihrer Kosmetik unglücklich waren. jobs.description:
Kleines Kraftwerk & Du

Wir sind Kleines Kraftwerk, ein junges Unternehmen mit großer Ambition.

In nur drei Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen und noch lange nicht am Ziel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt. Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen.

Du hast Lust, dass aus Performance-Daten und kreativen Ideen Ads entstehen, die nicht nur auffallen, sondern konvertieren?
Als unser:e neue:r
Creative Strategist:in

entwickelst du unsere Creative Strategy zu einem echten Wachstumstreiber. Die Basis steht: laufende Kampagnen, jede Menge Daten, ein Visual-Team und erste Testing-Ansätze. Du entwickelst daraus ein klares System – mit starken Angles und Hooks, strukturiertem Testing und einem Prozess, der erfolgreiche Creatives konsequent weiterentwickelt.
Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, unsere Creative Strategy maßgeblich zu prägen.

Bereit, aus starken Ideen ein skalierbares Creative-System zu machen?

Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst

Du bist die Übersetzung zwischen Performance-Daten und kreativer Umsetzung, nicht die Person, die selbst designt oder schneidet, sondern die, die genau weiß, warum ein Hook funktioniert oder nicht, und daraus die nächste Iteration ableitet.

Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks und Kampagnenkonzepte:
Für Meta, TikTok und Google übersetzt du Zielgruppen-Insights in Creatives, die konvertieren.
Du verantwortest unsere Creative Strategy
:
Du schaffst klare Prozesse, Briefing-Standards und ein Testing-System für skalierbare Performance Creatives.
Du identifizierst neue Creative-Potenziale:
Wettbewerber, Trends, Kundenfeedback und Social Listening nutzt du für neue Botschaften und Ideen.
Du erstellst klare Creative Briefings:
Vom Hook bis zum CTA gibst du unserem Visual-Team, Creator und externen Partnern eine klare Richtung.
Du etablierst strukturiertes Testing:
Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing testest du Hypothesen, wertest Ergebnisse aus und leitest nächste Iterationen ab.
Du skalierst erfolgreiche Creatives:
Anhand relevanter KPIs erkennst du erfolgreiche Konzepte, entwickelst sie weiter und wirkst Creative Fatigue entgegen.
Du sicherst unsere Markenkonsistenz:
Auch bei schnellem Testing bleiben Tonalität und Positionierung von kleines kraftwerk klar erkennbar.
Du nutzt AI als Beschleuniger:
AI-Tools helfen dir, Research und Variantenentwicklung schneller und effizienter zu machen.

Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst Performance Creatives aus der Praxis:
Du bringst ca. 3+ Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Strategist:in, im Performance Creative oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit, idealerweise im D2C-, Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.
Du weißt, was konvertiert:
Du hast bereits Creative-Konzepte entwickelt, die nicht nur gut aussahen, sondern nachweislich funktioniert und skaliert haben.
Du verstehst die relevanten Plattformen:
Meta, Google und TikTok Ads sowie die Struktur von Kampagnen und Creative-Tests sind dir vertraut. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit den Tools ist ein Plus.
Du denkst kreativ und datengetrieben:
KPIs wie Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA kannst du sicher einordnen und in konkrete Ideen und nächste Iterationen übersetzen.
Du kannst andere kreativ anleiten:
Du schreibst klare Briefings und arbeitest sicher mit internen Visual-Teams, externen Creator und Kooperationspartnern zusammen.
Du willst gestalten statt verwalten:
Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast Lust, bestehende Ansätze zu einem funktionierenden Creative-System weiterzuentwickeln.
Du bist offen für neue Tools:
AI nutzt du bereits für Creative Research und Produktion oder hast Lust, dich intensiv damit auseinanderzusetzen.
Du kommunizierst souverän:
Gute Englischkenntnisse für internationale Ad-Benchmarks sind ein Plus.

Bewirb dich nicht, wenn …

Du lieber nach Bauchgefühl arbeitest:
Daten und KPIs gehören für dich genauso zu guten Creatives wie starke Ideen.
Du klare Prozesse brauchst, um loszulegen:
Bei uns gibt es noch nicht für alles ein Handbuch. Genau das soll dich reizen.
Du operative Arbeit grundsätzlich ablehnst:
Dein Fokus liegt auf Strategie, aber du bist dir auch nicht zu schade, bei Bedarf selbst im Ads Manager mit anzupacken.

Worauf du dich freuen kannst

Creative Strategy aufbauen statt nur umsetzen:
Du bekommst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit beim Aufbau unserer Creative-Strategy-Funktion und kannst Prozesse, Testing-Strukturen und Standards von Grund auf mitgestalten.
Eine Ausgangslage mit echtem Potenzial:
Dich erwarten eine wachsende, aktive Zielgruppe und ein Marketing-Budget mit echtem Hebel, die ideale Basis, um Creatives systematisch zu testen, Learnings schnell umzusetzen und sichtbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Gemeinsam möchten wir wachsen:
Wir setzen auf ein starkes WIR-Gefühl, eine freundschaftliche Teamkultur, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
Raum für deine Ideen:
Deine Ideen werden gehört und gebraucht – du kannst dich einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und wirklich mitgestalten.
Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig:
Du hast flexible Arbeitszeiten, 2 Tage Home-Office pro Woche, 28 Tage Urlaub sowie 5 Tage Workation im Jahr. Außerdem hast du an deinem Geburtstag frei!
Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft liegen uns am Herzen:
Du erhältst Zuschüsse zu Wellpass und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie exklusive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte.
Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen:
Dich erwarten moderne, lichtdurchflutete Büros und eine phänomenale Dachterrasse, die zum Durchatmen und Austauschen einlädt.

Du willst Teil der Energiewende werden?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien. Join uns und werde Teil des Teams!

im Bereich erneuerbare Energien

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen: in einer dynamischen Umgebung, in der du viel Gestaltungsspielraum hast, Strukturen mit aufbauen kannst, eigene Entscheidungen triffst und direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens nimmst.

Dabei ist uns egal, woher du kommst, an was du glaubst, wen du liebst, womit du dich identifizierst, wie alt du bist, ob du neurodivers bist oder eine Behinderung hast – die Welt ist bunt und wir können es kaum erwarten, von dir zu lesen! Alle Geschlechter sind Willkommen!

Wir sind kein fertiger Mittelstand sondern Start-Up auf Wachstumskurs.

### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you interested in a meaningful and impactful career? Would you like to contribute to protecting people and the environment and accelerating a statewide transition to sustainable pest management? The Department of Pesticide Regulation (DPR) could be the place for you! The Department of Pesticide Regulation's (DPR) Enforcement Regional Office Branch is recruiting a Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) in the Northern Regional Office (NRO), located in Sacramento.
  

  

Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) at the advanced journey level position performs professional scientific analyses and fieldwork associated with appropriate use of pesticides. Independently applies scientific methods and principles to perform unusually difficult environmental investigations, analyses, research and studies for compliance with toxic and hazardous pesticide restrictions. Provides oversight of enforcement compliance to maintain statewide uniformity. Incumbent generates, compiles, and assesses scientific data for regulatory compliance with human health and environmental requirements, providing protections from pesticide use on human health, non\-target vegetation, food safety, surface/ground water, wildlife, and air quality.


You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


The incumbent in a single floor building, under artificial lighting. The collection of samples as indicated for this position requires the ability to lift and carry a minimum of 25 pounds, bend, squat, and climb over boxes, containers, or pallets; travel by automobile or air is required to different areas of the State. Occasional statewide travel is required. There is field work performed requiring the ability to maneuver over uneven ground and work in outdoor conditions. Occasional irregular work schedules may be required. Travel may include overnight stays several days each month.
  

  

**NOTE:** This position may be eligible for hybrid telework under Government Code 14200 for eligible applicants residing in California, subject to the candidate meeting telework eligibility criteria set forth in the CalEPA telework policy and/or future program need. Employees not residing in California are not eligible for telework. Regardless of telework eligibility, all employees may be required to report to the position’s designated headquarters location, as indicated on their duty statement, at their own expense.
  

  

Beginning July 1, 2026, it is anticipated the position will be office\-centered and employees will be expected to report to the office at least four days per week.

### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you interested in a meaningful and impactful career? Would you like to contribute to protecting people and the environment and accelerating a statewide transition to sustainable pest management? The Department of Pesticide Regulation (DPR) could be the place for you!
  

  

Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) acts as the scientific expert on the protection of surface water from pesticide contamination. The Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) independently identifies problems, develops courses of action, and conducts complex scientific investigations and studies. The incumbent may help lead or coordinate specific monitoring efforts for the Surface Water Protection Program and act as a subject matter expert analyzing monitoring and environmental data to support DPR's continuous evaluation and mitigation efforts.
  

  

Specific responsibilities include:


* Conceives, proposes, plans, organizes, and directs complex surface water protection tasks, including primary and lead responsibility on scientific and technical evaluation of pesticide impacts to surface water.
* Independently conceives plans and implements complex studies to assess the spatial and temporal distributions of pesticide detections (and associated toxicity and aquatic macro\-invertebrate impairment) in surface water and sediment.
* Provides quality assurance and quality control of monitoring methods, analytical methods and monitoring data. Gathers, manages, assesses, and interprets monitoring and environmental data using a variety of tools and techniques including statistics, programming language (e.g., SQL, R, Python), geographic information systems (GIS), databases (e.g., MS Access), and/or other computer modeling in support of Surface Water's monitoring and mitigation efforts. Designs or defines needed equipment and instrumentation required for research, or develops new research methods to solve the most difficult surface water monitoring needs.
* Coordinates with state and federal pesticide and water quality agencies on scientific and regulatory projects of shared interest; consults with agencies, universities, growers, registrants, County Agricultural Commissioners, and stakeholders on complex monitoring and mitigation studies and other ecological health projects. Interacts with an interdisciplinary team of scientists.
* Writes reports, documents and technical publications, and makes oral presentations to governmental entities, professional societies, stakeholders, or pesticide user groups. Serves as technical advisor for programmatic or project needs.
* Performs critical review of data and proposed projects submitted by registrants, CDPR staff, and other agencies for scientific integrity and application to program objectives.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Employee must have the ability to work in a high\-rise office environment and ability to use a computer monitor, mouse, and keyboard within an 8\-hr day. Employee must be capable of performing field studies and site visits that may involve hiking or climbing in areas with moderate slopes, unpaved surfaces, undeveloped roads, and other areas or structures where studies may be required. The employee must have the ability to conduct fieldwork for long hours under a variety of climatic conditions and, also, operate vehicles on public roadways or travel to remote areas. Travel that includes flying and/or driving on short notice and overnight stays will be required on trips to various field locations and community/board meetings. Employee may occasionally be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in order to minimize exposure to hazards. PPE include, but not limited to, gloves, safety glasses, ear plugs, hard hats, coveralls, and tight\-fitting respiratory protective equipment. When respiratory protective equipment is required, the employee must adhere to the fitting requirements stated in DPR’s respiratory protection policy.
  

  

**NOTE:** This position may be eligible for hybrid telework under Government Code 14200 for eligible applicants residing in California, subject to the candidate meeting telework eligibility criteria set forth in the CalEPA telework policy and/or future program need. Employees not residing in California are not eligible for telework. Regardless of telework eligibility, all employees may be required to report to the position’s designated headquarters location, as indicated on their duty statement, at their own expense.
  

  

Beginning July 1, 2026, it is anticipated the position will be office\-centered and employees will be expected to report to the office at least four days per week.

jobs.title: GHD Graduate Program 2026/27 - WA - Graduate Hydrology and Water Resources
jobs.description:
**We’re GHD.**

We don’t do hair. But we do straighten out some of the world’s biggest challenges.


We’re engineers, scientists, designers, architects, planners, advisors, innovators and change makers, committed to making energy, water and communities sustainable for generations to come.


Since 1928, we’ve been wholly owned by our employees. Today, we are 11,000 diverse and skilled individuals working in over 160 offices across five continents — Asia, Australia, Europe, North and South America, and the Pacific region.  



**Who could you be at GHD?**

Our Water team is looking for a **Hydrology and Water Resources Graduate** to join our **2027 Graduate Program** , commencing in **February 2027\.**

If you're passionate about water resources, enjoy working with data and modelling tools, and are interested in understanding how surface water and groundwater systems interact, we'd love to hear from you.


This is an excellent opportunity to work alongside experienced hydrologists, hydraulic modellers, hydrogeologists, and water resources engineers on a diverse range of projects across the mining, infrastructure, energy, transport, water, and environmental sectors.  



You'll gain hands\-on experience across a range of activities, including:


* Hydrological and hydraulic modelling for water resources, infrastructure, mining, and environmental projects.
* Flood studies, drainage assessments, and water management investigations.
* Surface water and groundwater interaction assessments.
* Water resource planning and management.
* Catchment analysis and flood risk assessment.
* Environmental approval and impact assessment projects.
Multidisciplinary collaboration with engineers, hydrogeologists, environmental scientists, planners, GIS specialists, and project managers.  
* 

Our two\-year Graduate Development Program is designed to give you a smooth start to your consulting career. Alongside your peers, managers and mentors, we’ll help you detangle any challenges along the way. You’ll work collaboratively with peers across other disciplines within GHD, as well as with our clients, and connect across the business to share insights, knowledge and improve your overall technical capabilities.  



**A frizz\-free application process:**

We want your journey to be as smooth as possible, so here’s everything you need to help you prep like a pro:


* **Your CV:** This gives us a snapshot of what you’ve studied and your experiences, both paid and unpaid.
* **A cover letter:** Think of this as your chance to show us where you’d love to grow within GHD, while letting your communication skills shine.
* **Your transcript:** This helps us understand what you’ve been learning, from your core subjects to the electives that sparked your curiosity.

**Your journey to joining GHD:**

Here’s what to expect, step by step:


* **Virtual Assessments:** If you make it through the first stage, you’ll record some answers to a few straightforward questions and complete some cognitive games. This helps us get a better sense of your work style and alignment to GHD Graduate roles.
* **Meet the team:** If you’re successful, you’ll have a face\-to\-face interview (wherever possible) with your prospective team. We’ll chat through some *behavioural based questions* to learn more about your skills and experience. It’s also a chance for you to get to know us!
* **Offer:** Congratulations! We’ll talk through all the finer details, like salary, your start date, our onboarding process and what to expect before your first day.

We’re committed to being as inclusive as possible and giving everyone an equitable chance of getting through our application process. **If you identify as someone who is neurodiverse or have a disability** and need adjustments to any part of the process, let us know in your application form—we’re here to help.  



**Start dates and opportunities**

Most of our full\-time roles kick off in February 2027, though some teams might have earlier start dates in mid\-2026\. Plus, there might also be casual work opportunities throughout your final year of study to give you a head start.

Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.

jobs.description:

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high\-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

  

The Senior Technical Project Manager (PM) will lead and manage complex environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance projects involving chlorinated solvent impacts in soil, groundwater, sediment, soil vapor, and indoor air. The role requires strong technical leadership, client management, project delivery, staff development, and business development capabilities. Experience with large industrial, aerospace, manufacturing, military, and brownfield remediation programs is highly desirable.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project and Program Management**


* Manage large\-scale environmental remediation projects from proposal through closure.
* Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and health and safety plans.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of geologists, engineers, hydrogeologists, risk assessors, and environmental scientists.
* Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and forecasting.
* Coordinate subcontractors, laboratories, drilling contractors, and remediation vendors.
* Maintain quality assurance and quality control standards.


**Technical Leadership**


* Serve as a technical lead for sites impacted by:
	+ PCE (Tetrachloroethylene)
	+ TCE (Trichloroethylene)
	+ cis\-1,2\-DCE
	+ Vinyl Chloride
	+ Other chlorinated VOCs
* Design and oversee:
	+ Site investigations
	+ Groundwater characterization
	+ Soil vapor intrusion assessments
	+ Human health and ecological risk assessments
	+ Remedial investigations/feasibility studies (RI/FS)
	+ Corrective action programs
* Evaluate and implement remediation technologies such as:
	+ In situ chemical reduction (ISCR)
	+ In situ chemical oxidation (ISCO)
	+ Enhanced reductive dechlorination (ERD)
	+ Thermal remediation
	+ Soil vapor extraction (SVE)
	+ Dual\-phase extraction (DPE)
	+ Air sparging
	+ Monitored natural attenuation (MNA)

* Act as primary client contact for key accounts.

* Lead proposal preparation and pricing.
* Support capture planning and opportunity pursuit.
* Identify new clients and expand existing accounts.
* Participate in industry organizations and conferences.


**Regulatory Expertise**



Demonstrated experience working with:


* EPA CERCLA/Superfund programs
* RCRA Corrective Action
* State cleanup programs
* Vapor intrusion guidance
* UST and industrial facility closure programs
* California DTSC and Regional Water Board programs


**Qualifications**


* BS in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Hydrogeology, Geology, or related field.
* 12\+ years of environmental consulting experience.
* 7\+ years managing complex remediation projects.
* Demonstrated success managing projects exceeding $500K to $5M\+ annually.
* Significant chlorinated solvent investigation and remediation experience.
* California PE, PG, CHG, PMP, REM, CHMM (preferred)

jobs.title: Creative Lead, Paid Social
jobs.description:
Hims \& Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health \& wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.


Hims \& Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how\-it\-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent\-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers\-professionals.

**About the Role:**
-------------------


We're standing up a new in house video arm for paid social at Hims \& Hers, bringing high volume ad production in house so we can move faster and work across every category and both brands, Hims and Hers. The Creative Lead is a foundational hire in that build, not a role slotting into an existing team. **It's a hands on role based in Los Angeles**, with in person attendance on set on a varied schedule that follows the shoots, not a typical office week.


As Creative Lead, you're the creative engine of the pod, partnering with a marketing Creative Strategist who sets the initial vision, direction, and scripts for each concept. From there, it's on you to bring that vision to life visually, directing the shoot, shaping the look, and pulling in your Producer and editorial counterparts to get each concept shot, cut, and shipped at volume.


This is a hands on, wear many hats role. You're not waiting around for a finished brief, you're a genuine creative partner from the earliest idea, and you're comfortable adapting fast as priorities, categories, and brands shift.


You'll work across both Hims and Hers and each category, taking direction from Strategists on either line of business and executing it with your own creative craft. Producing at the volume this pod needs means staying hands on across the whole path from concept to a launched, high performing ad, not just owning one piece of it.

**You Will:**
-------------

* Partner with the marketing Creative Strategist from the earliest concept stage, translating their vision and scripts into a fully realized visual approach.
* Own the visual execution of the pod's output end to end, bringing the Strategist's scripts and concepts to life on screen, and contributing to copy or hooks when it helps.
* Be ready to direct shoots in person, giving real time notes to talent, crew, and production, and step behind the camera yourself (when needed) for lean, quick turnaround setups.
* Adjust lines on set when needed to keep the words and the visuals in sync. The scripts themselves come from the Strategist, but your read on what's working in the room matters.
* Shoot roughly 5 to 10 variants per concept to feed the post production iteration pipeline.
* Partner closely with the Producer on shoot planning, covering locations, talent, props, wardrobe, and shot lists.
* Collaborate with editorial and post production on every cut, giving clear, specific feedback to keep the work aligned with the original creative vision.
* Maintain a high bar for craft across the board, composition, typography, color, motion, clarity, and voice, even at high volume and speed.
* Translate what's winning in performance back into visual direction for future concepts and shoots, sharing insights with the Strategist to help shape future scripts.

**You Have:**
-------------

* 6 to 9 years of experience in art direction, video direction, or design, with copywriting or scripting as a secondary skill, and a portfolio spanning concept development and video first paid social or branded content, not just execution of others' briefs.
* Demonstrated experience developing visual treatments, along with giving clear creative direction to crews, talent, and editors.
* Hands on shooting experience, comfortable operating a camera yourself for lean shoots, not only directing a crew.
* Comfortable contributing to copy, hooks, or scripts when it's useful, even though scripts are typically owned by the Creative Strategist.
* Proven ability to concept and ship video first ads quickly in fast paced, high volume environments, balancing craft and business needs to deliver effective solutions with minimal guidance.
* Deep understanding of platform best practices for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap, and emerging short form formats.
* Comfort collaborating across functions with editorial, production, and other internal creative teams, including distributed or offshore teams, to protect creative vision through iteration.
* Comfort adapting your craft and creative point of view across multiple brands, categories, and audiences within a shared production system, rather than staying limited to a single brand.
* Strong creative instincts across both visual storytelling and voice, with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other relevant AI creative tools.
* Comfort working with performance data as a guide for creative decisions, not just craft instinct, exercising sound judgment in balancing creative risk against practical constraints driven by the business.
* A true go getter, comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting fast as the needs of the business change, in a lean, fast moving in house team rather than an agency structure.

**Portfolio Requirements**


Please include a link to your portfolio or reel showing your role in concept development, storyboarding, visual direction, and scripting or copywriting where relevant, not just finished footage. Be clear about your specific contribution, whether concept, storyboard, director, DP, writer, or editor, on each project.

**Overview**
------------


As Group Manager, Enterprise Sales, you will build and lead Intuit's Enterprise sales team focused on the largest accounting firms in the country. Your team's job is to bring agentic AI workflows into these firms so their best people spend less time processing and more time advising, using Intuit Accountant Suite (IAS) Enterprise and Intuit AI Tools, including Agent Studio.

  

You are being hired to stand up this team, not inherit one. You will hire, ramp, and develop a group of Enterprise Account Executives who own complex, multi\-stakeholder deals with large firms (Top 100 US firms). You carry team quota\-bearing responsibility for net new Enterprise revenue and own the operating rhythm, territory design, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and coaching, that turns a brand\-new motion into a repeatable one.

  

This is a builder's mandate as much as a leadership one. You will partner with Firm Engagement Managers, Marketing, Product, and Channel to define how Intuit sells and delivers its Forward Deploy co\-build model at scale, and you will be the connective link between your team's work in the field and Intuit's senior leadership.

 **Responsibilities**

**Team Building \& Talent Development**

* Hire, onboard, and ramp a team of Enterprise Account Executives, building a repeatable hiring bar and onboarding motion.
* Coach reps on enterprise deal strategy, multi\-threading, and executive engagement; spend real time in the field, in deal reviews, and in the room with reps on their highest\-stakes calls.
* Build career pathing, recognition, and a team culture that retains top enterprise talent and creates bench strength for future growth.
* Identify and address underperformance directly and early; recognize and grow top performers deliberately.

 **Team Pipeline \& Territory Leadership**

* Own team quota for net new IAS and Intuit Intelligence revenue; build and defend a pipeline sufficient to hit and exceed the number every quarter.
* Design and own territory and account segmentation across the team, balancing firm size, technology maturity, staffing model, and strategic alignment with IAS and Intuit Intelligence, always pointing reps at the highest\-leverage targets first.
* Track buying signals across the team's territory, including firm growth and AI readiness/usage, and coach reps to engage at the right moment.
* Report pipeline health and deal progress; updates flow directly to Intuit's senior leadership.

 **Complex Deal Leadership**

* Coach reps through the full sales cycle end to end: discovery, needs assessment, solution design, demonstration, proposal, negotiation, and close, on deals that routinely span multiple stakeholders.
* Act as executive sponsor and escalation point on the team's highest\-stakes deals, engaging directly with managing partners, CTOs, and C\-suite stakeholders when a deal needs leadership altitude to move.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Marketing, Product, Channel, and senior leadership to align resources and accelerate execution inside the team's most complex, multi\-party opportunities.
* Coach reps to build and manage multi\-threaded relationships within each account: managing stakeholders for vision alignment, IT and operations leads for technical validation, and domain experts for workflow buy\-in.

 **IAS \& Intuit Intelligence Adoption Strategy**

  

* Drive team\-wide focus on post\-close activation of IAS and Intuit Intelligence, tracking usage across accounts, surfacing adoption risk, and engaging firm leadership when adoption stalls.
* Identify and prioritize expansion opportunities across the book of business: new service lines, additional seats, and deeper AI agentic workflow deployments.
* Build the playbooks and systems that turn client relationships into partnerships that outlast the initial transaction, and outlast any single rep on the team.

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 7\+ years of quota\-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS, financial technology, or professional services software, with a proven track record of personally closing complex, multi\-stakeholder deals.
* 2\+ years of people leadership experience hiring, ramping, and coaching enterprise or strategic account sellers to quota attainment.
* Demonstrated ability to build a team, pipeline, and operating rhythm from a standing start, not simply run one that already exists.
* Strong deal management and forecasting discipline at the team level: you can roll up a forecast across multiple reps and defend it with confidence, not optimism.
* Executive presence and communication skills: able to engage credibly with managing partners, firm CTOs, and C\-suite stakeholders, and just as credible communicating up to Intuit's senior leadership.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and modern sales productivity and analytics platforms.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to gain cross\-functional alignment within Intuit and across accounting firms.

 **Preferred**

  

* Experience selling to, or leading a team that sells to, accounting firms or CPA firms. You understand firm structure, partnership dynamics, decision\-making timelines, and what ROI means to a managing partner.
* Experience building or scaling a new sales motion or segment inside a larger sales organization.
* Prior experience selling or positioning AI\-powered workflow automation tools, and the ability to translate agentic AI capability into firm\-level productivity and revenue impact.
* Understanding of the accounting firm technology market and competitive landscape, and how enterprise firms evaluate technology decisions.
* Experience managing or participating in a co\-build, Forward Deploy, or professional services engagement model alongside a technical delivery team.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Capture Manager - Remediation and Technical
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**



APTIM is seeking a hands\-on Federal Capture Manager to help win strategic environmental remediation and technical services work. This role is ideal for an ambitious, proven capture professional who is ready to assume ownership of high\-priority pursuits and gain increased visibility and influence within a growing federal business. The position may be filled at the Senior Manager or Director level based on experience and demonstrated capture success.





The successful candidate will own assigned pursuits from early identification and qualification through capture, proposal development, negotiation and award. This individual will shape opportunities before solicitation release, develop customer and competitive intelligence, build executable win strategies, lead cross\-functional pursuit teams and remain personally accountable for advancing opportunities across the finish line. This is a capture lead position, not a proposal manager role. The Capture Manager will establish the strategy and maintain ownership and continuity throughout proposal development, negotiations and award.





The position will focus on federal environmental remediation pursuits, including investigations and remedial actions driven by CERCLA and RCRA, solicited under MATOCs, SATOCs, HTRW A\-E, and stand\-alone contracts to address environmental contaminants of concern (e.g. PFAS, VOCs, metals, radiological, etc.) for Department of War and civilian\-agency customers. The successful candidate will work directly with RTS leadership and experienced operational and technical teams, with an opportunity to grow into broader business\-development leadership based on performance.





**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**


* Contribute to the RTS growth strategy and build a qualified pipeline of strategic federal environmental opportunities with focus on contracts valued at $15M or greater.
* Own assigned pursuits from early identification and qualification through capture, proposal development, negotiation and award.
* Shape opportunities before solicitation release by developing a thorough understanding of customer missions, priorities, funding, acquisition strategies, evaluation criteria and procurement timelines.
* Develop and execute comprehensive capture plans, customer engagement strategies, competitive assessments, teaming strategies, win themes, discriminators and price\-to\-win approaches.
* Translate APTIM's technical capabilities, operational strengths and past performance into differentiated, customer\-focused solutions.
* Assemble and lead cross\-functional pursuit teams comprising operational, technical, contracts, legal, pricing, estimating and proposal resources.
* Lead opportunity qualification and governance reviews, presenting clear recommendations regarding competitive position, probability of win, required investment, resource needs and bid strategy.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with federal customers, industry partners, small\-business teammates and internal account and operational leaders.
* Monitor federal market conditions, customer priorities, competitors, acquisition trends and emerging technologies and translate that intelligence into actionable pursuit strategies.
* Maintain accurate pipeline information, capture milestones, pursuit investments, forecasts and action plans in APTIM's customer relationship management system.
* Manage multiple pursuits with urgency and discipline, communicate progress clearly and escalate barriers and resource requirements early.

### **Job Description and Duties**


The Measurement Assessment and Research Section (MARS) operates the Mobile Source Emissions Testing Facility in Sacramento, equipped with a heavy\-duty chassis dynamometer, advanced laboratory analyzers, Portable Emissions Measurement Systems (PEMS), and the Portable Emissions Acquisition System (PEAQS) to produce high\-quality, legally defensible emissions data. MARS’s mission is to support the development of heavy\-duty on\-road and off\-road vehicle regulations, strengthen emissions inventories, inform enforcement actions, advance the Clean Truck Check program, and drive research initiatives. Through surveillance testing of in\-use on\-road and off\-road heavy\-duty vehicles and equipment, MARS provides critical insights into real\-world emissions performance and regulatory effectiveness. MARS also serves as a platform for evaluating and demonstrating new test approaches, advancing innovative methods for measuring in\-use emissions, and improving testing capabilities. Working collaboratively with CARB mobile source workgroups, MARS develops and executes test plans, conducts comprehensive emissions testing, and delivers robust data analyses to guide policy decisions and protect air quality. These efforts provide the scientific foundation to achieve reductions in criteria pollutants, greenhouse gases, and toxic air contaminants from the heavy\-duty sector.  

MARS is seeking an Air Pollution Specialist to perform complex technical work related to in\-use emissions characterization of heavy\-duty (HD) on\-road and off\-road vehicles and equipment. The incumbent will conduct laboratory emissions testing using a heavy\-duty chassis dynamometer, perform on\-road emissions measurements with portable emissions measurement systems (PEMS), and ensure compliance with established test procedures, data quality objectives, and safety protocols. Duties include developing and applying analytical methods for emissions data processing, validation, and interpretation; analyzing large datasets using computational tools; designing and executing test plans; operating advanced emissions measurement systems; coordinating test resources; and preparing technical reports in support of regulatory programs, research initiatives, and emissions assessments, while working independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to support CARB’s mission to protect air quality.  

This position offers a balanced mix of laboratory, field, and office\-based work and supports CARB’s mission by advancing in\-use emissions measurement techniques and evaluating emerging heavy\-duty vehicle technologies. The incumbent's position and reporting office is located at: CARB's \- Depot Park Facility, 8311 Galena Ave., Sacramento, CA 95828\.
